40/// @brief What the catalog says about a model type.
41struct ModelInfo {
42 /// @brief Whether a shared singleton is equivalent to a private instance.
43 bool stateless = false;
44 /// @brief Whether the model can be shared by an instance key, so an alias may give `instance` an expression.
45 bool keyed = false;
46};

48/// @brief One effect an action declares, as the catalog states it.
49struct ActionEffect {
50 /// @brief What the effect is: `updates`, `changes`, `changesInstance` or `none`.
51 std::string kind;
52 /// @brief The wire name of the record the effect names; absent for `changesInstance` and `none`.
53 std::optional<std::string> record;
54
55 /// @brief Memberwise equality.
56 /// @param lhs One effect.
57 /// @param rhs The other.
58 /// @return True when kind and record match.
59 friend bool operator==(ActionEffect const& lhs, ActionEffect const& rhs) = default;
60};
61
62/// @brief A record an action's result holds, as the catalog states it.
63struct ActionRecordInfo {
64 /// @brief The record's wire name.
65 std::string record;
66 /// @brief The record's key field; absent for a keyless record.
67 std::optional<std::string> keyField;
68 /// @brief The JSON paths at which the result holds the record; `""` is the result itself.
69 std::vector<std::string> paths;
70
71 /// @brief Memberwise equality.
72 /// @param lhs One entry.
73 /// @param rhs The other.
74 /// @return True when record, key field and paths match.
75 friend bool operator==(ActionRecordInfo const& lhs, ActionRecordInfo const& rhs) = default;
76};

78/// @brief What the catalog says about an action.
79struct ActionInfo {
80 /// @brief The registered type id of the model the action belongs to.
81 std::string modelType;
82 /// @brief The fields of the action's reply rows that the server calculates; an `optimistic` write may not name
83 /// them.
84 std::vector<std::string> calculatedFields;
85 /// @brief The reply fields the server marks `secret`.
86 std::vector<std::string> secretFields;
87 /// @brief Whether the action sends a credential.
88 bool credential = false;
89 /// @brief When the action's result is a record, the names of its members that hold a list: what a `patch` or
90 /// `optimistic` of a query of the action may name as its `at`. Empty when the catalog does not say, or the
91 /// result is not a record.
92 std::optional<std::vector<std::string>> listFields;
93 /// @brief What the action declares it changes. Absent when it declared nothing, which makes it a read; present
94 /// and empty is not produced by the registry.
95 std::optional<std::vector<ActionEffect>> effects;
96 /// @brief The records the action's result holds, with the paths to each. Empty when it holds none or the
97 /// catalog does not say.
98 std::vector<ActionRecordInfo> records;
99};

101/// @brief The facts load-time validation needs from the application's catalog. Local mode answers them from the
102/// model registry in-process, the server at registration, a remote client from the UI service's catalog.
103///
104/// A lookup left empty skips the rules that need it: `model` the unknown-model and keyed-instance rules; `action`
105/// the unknown-action, wrong-model, optimistic and offline rules.
106struct Catalog {
107 /// @brief Looks up a model type by its registered type id.
108 std::function<std::optional<ModelInfo>(std::string_view typeId)> model;
109 /// @brief Looks up an action by its id.
110 std::function<std::optional<ActionInfo>(std::string_view actionId)> action;
111 /// @brief The schema JSON of an action, as `forms::schemaJson<A>()` emits it: what a `form` node builds its form
112 /// from. Local mode answers it from the action registry, a remote client from the server's `schemas`.
113 /// Empty: a `form` node is reported and shown as a muted text.
114 std::function<std::optional<std::string>(std::string_view actionId)> schema;
115 /// @brief The `v-*` view document whose `v-query` is an action, as `views::viewSchemaJson<V>()` emits it: what a
116 /// `collection` node naming that action builds its collection from. Empty: a `collection` node is
117 /// reported and shown as a muted text.
118 std::function<std::optional<std::string>(std::string_view actionId)> view;
119 /// @brief The `w-*` wizard document whose first step is an action, as `flows::wizardSchemaJson<W>()` emits it:
120 /// what a `wizard` node naming that action builds its wizard from. Empty: a `wizard` node is reported and
121 /// shown as a muted text.
122 std::function<std::optional<std::string>(std::string_view actionId)> wizard;
123};
124
125/// @brief A `Catalog::view` or `Catalog::wizard` lookup over documents by action id.
126/// @param documents The documents by action id; the lookup keeps its own copy.
127/// @return The lookup.
128[[nodiscard]] inline std::function<std::optional<std::string>(std::string_view)> documentLookup(
129 std::map<std::string, std::string, std::less<>> documents) {
130 return [known = std::make_shared<std::map<std::string, std::string, std::less<>> const>(std::move(documents))](
131 std::string_view actionId) -> std::optional<std::string> {
132 auto const found = known->find(actionId);
133 if (found == known->end()) {
134 return std::nullopt;
135 }
136 return found->second;
137 };
138}

146/// @brief How a model alias binds its instance (spec 5 §5).
147enum class InstanceMode : std::uint8_t {
148 Default, ///< None named: `shared` when the catalog marks the model stateless, `private` otherwise.
149 Private, ///< An instance of the scope's own, released when the scope unmounts.
150 Shared, ///< A stateless model's instance, its queries cached with other screens'; refused for a stateful model.
151 Keyed, ///< The shared instance an expression's key selects.
152 Borrowed, ///< The opener's binding of an alias (`{"from": alias}`), for a screen opened as a dialog.
153};

220/// @brief What a mutation run does while another is in flight.
221enum class Concurrency : std::uint8_t {
222 Exclusive, ///< The run is refused.
223 Serial, ///< Runs queue, one queue per `serialKey`.
224 Latest, ///< Every run is sent; only the newest reply applies.
225 Parallel, ///< Every run is sent; replies apply as they arrive.
226};

228/// @brief An `optimistic` write: the row a mutation run predicts before its reply.
229struct OptimisticDecl {
230 /// @brief The query whose cached list it writes.

232 /// @brief The member of the query's record value that holds the list; empty when the value is the list itself.
233 std::string at;
234 /// @brief The row key to write, read against the run's body bound as `body`.
235 ExprPtr key;
236 /// @brief The predicted row, read against the run's body bound as `body`.
237 ExprPtr with;
238};

240struct Command;

242/// @brief A command list, run as one batch.
243using Commands = std::vector<Command>;
244
245/// @brief The commands of `ui/1` (spec 5 §8, spec 6).
246enum class CommandKind : std::uint8_t {
247 Set, ///< `{"set": "name.path", "value": e}`
248 Reset, ///< `{"reset": "name"}`
249 Run, ///< `{"run": "m", "body": e?, "as": "x"?, "each": e?}`
250 Refetch, ///< `{"refetch": "q"}`
251 Open, ///< `{"open": "dialog"}`
252 Close, ///< `{"close": "dialog" | "self"}`
253 Navigate, ///< `{"navigate": "screen" | {"route": e}, "params": e, "as": ..., "onResult": [...], ...}`
254 Return, ///< `{"return": e}`
255 Focus, ///< `{"focus": "id"}`
256 Host, ///< `{"host": "name", "args": e?}`
257 SwitchBackend, ///< `{"switchBackend": "name"}`
258 ResetPrefs, ///< `{"resetPrefs": "point" | "all"}`
259 SetLocale, ///< `{"setLocale": "de"}`
260 Notify, ///< `{"notify": e, "role": "success"}`
261 Seq, ///< `{"seq": [...]}`
262 All, ///< `{"all": [...]}`
263 If, ///< `{"if": [cond, [...], [...]]}`
264 CancelClose, ///< `{"cancelClose": true}`
265 Retry, ///< `{"retry": true}`
266 SignIn, ///< `{"signIn": {"from": "m"}}`
267 SignOut, ///< `{"signOut": true}`
268 Upload, ///< `{"upload": e, "to": "m", "as": "x"?, "id": "t"?, "into": "bytes"?, "nameAs"?, "typeAs"?}`
269 /// `{"download": e, "save": "dialog", "name": e?}` or `{"download": e, "to": "preview", "as": "url"}`, either
270 /// with `"from": "bytes"`, a `name` and a `type`
271 Download,
272};
273
274/// @brief One command. Which members a kind uses is listed with each member.
275struct Command {
276 /// @brief The kind.
277 CommandKind kind = CommandKind::Set;
278 /// @brief The command's JSON Pointer.
279 std::string path;
280 /// @brief The name it acts on: `set`'s `name.path`; the state of `reset`; the mutation of `run`, `signIn` and
281 /// `upload`; the query of `refetch`; the element of `open`, `close` and `focus`; the screen of
282 /// `navigate`; the name of `host`, `switchBackend`, `setLocale`; the point of `resetPrefs`; the state of
283 /// a `download` to preview.
284 std::string target;
285 /// @brief The main expression: `set`'s value, `run`'s body, `navigate`'s params, `return`'s value, `host`'s
286 /// args, `notify`'s message, `if`'s condition, the file of `upload` and `download`.
287 ExprPtr value;
288 /// @brief The second expression: `run`'s `each`, `navigate`'s `route`, `download`'s suggested `name`,
289 /// `focus`'s `row`.
290 ExprPtr extra;
291 /// @brief A binding name: `run`'s and `upload`'s `as`.
292 std::string binding;
293 /// @brief A closed option: `navigate`'s `as`, `notify`'s `role`, `download`'s `save` or `to`.
294 std::string option;
295 /// @brief The transfer id of `upload`, whose progress is an element value.
296 std::string transfer;
297 /// @brief Whether the file moves inline: `download`'s `"from": "bytes"`, `upload`'s `"into": "bytes"`.
298 bool bytes = false;
299 /// @brief `download`'s media type of inline bytes.
300 ExprPtr mediaType;
301 /// @brief `upload`'s body members for an inline file's name and media type; empty for none.
302 std::string nameAs;
303 /// @brief See `nameAs`.
304 std::string typeAs;
305 /// @brief Nested commands: `seq` and `all`; `if`'s then branch; `navigate`'s `onResult`.
306 Commands commands;
307 /// @brief The alternative: `if`'s else branch; `navigate`'s `onCancel`.
308 Commands alternative;
309};

389struct DocNode;
390
391/// @brief A shared, immutable view node.
392using DocNodePtr = std::shared_ptr<DocNode const>;
393
394/// @brief A view node of the document (spec 5 §9), or a structured part of one (a table column, a tab, a switch
395/// case, a menu item, an `a11y`, `drag`, `drop` or `action` record, a form field overlay).
396///
397/// Properties are kept by their document keys, so the interpreter reads a kind's properties by name; which keys a
398/// kind has, and what shape each takes, is the kind table of `docs/spec/ui/document.md`.
399struct DocNode {
400 /// @brief The node kind (`text`, `table`, …), or for a part its part kind (`column`, `tab`, `case`, …).
401 std::string kind;
402 /// @brief The element id; empty when none is given.
403 std::string id;
404 /// @brief The node's JSON Pointer.
405 std::string path;
406 /// @brief Expression properties, by key.
407 std::map<std::string, ExprPtr, std::less<>> props;
408 /// @brief Command lists, by key (`onClick`, …), including a custom node's `on` events as `on.<event>`.
409 std::map<std::string, Commands, std::less<>> events;
410 /// @brief Child node lists, by key (`children`, `header`, `loading`, `error`, `default`, `cell`, `fallback`).
411 std::map<std::string, std::vector<DocNodePtr>, std::less<>> children;
412 /// @brief Structured parts, by key (`columns`, `tabs`, `cases`, `items`, `a11y`, `action`, `fields`, …).
413 std::map<std::string, std::vector<DocNodePtr>, std::less<>> parts;
414 /// @brief Plain string properties, by key (`testId`, `surface`, `name` of a custom node, `model` and `action`
415 /// of a form, `point` of `customize`, `role` of `a11y`, a column's `id`, …).
416 std::map<std::string, std::string, std::less<>> names;
417 /// @brief Key bindings: chord to commands.
418 std::map<std::string, Commands, std::less<>> keys;
419 /// @brief Literal flags, by key (`showLabel` of an input).
420 std::map<std::string, bool, std::less<>> flags;
421 /// @brief The declarations of the scope the node creates (dialog, drawer, switch case, `forEach` or `table`
422 /// row); empty for a node that creates none.
423 std::optional<ScopeDecl> scope;
424
425 /// @brief An expression property.
426 /// @param key The key.
427 /// @return The expression, or `nullptr` when absent.
428 [[nodiscard]] ExprPtr prop(std::string_view key) const {
429 auto const found = props.find(key);
430 return found == props.end() ? nullptr : found->second;
431 }
432
433 /// @brief A command list.
434 /// @param key The key.
435 /// @return The commands, or `nullptr` when absent.
436 [[nodiscard]] Commands const* event(std::string_view key) const {
437 auto const found = events.find(key);
438 return found == events.end() ? nullptr : &found->second;
439 }
440
441 /// @brief A child node list.
442 /// @param key The key.
443 /// @return The nodes; empty when absent.
444 [[nodiscard]] std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes(std::string_view key) const {
445 auto const found = children.find(key);
446 return found == children.end() ? std::span<DocNodePtr const>{} : std::span<DocNodePtr const>{found->second};
447 }
448
449 /// @brief A list of parts.
450 /// @param key The key.
451 /// @return The parts; empty when absent.
452 [[nodiscard]] std::span<DocNodePtr const> partList(std::string_view key) const {
453 auto const found = parts.find(key);
454 return found == parts.end() ? std::span<DocNodePtr const>{} : std::span<DocNodePtr const>{found->second};
455 }
456
457 /// @brief A plain string property.
458 /// @param key The key.
459 /// @return The string; empty when absent.
460 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view name(std::string_view key) const {
461 auto const found = names.find(key);
462 return found == names.end() ? std::string_view{} : std::string_view{found->second};
463 }
464
465 /// @brief A literal flag.
466 /// @param key The key.
467 /// @return Its value; `false` when absent.
468 [[nodiscard]] bool flag(std::string_view key) const {
469 auto const found = flags.find(key);
470 return found != flags.end() && found->second;
471 }
472
473 /// @brief A literal flag whose absence means something other than `false`.
474 /// @param key The key.
475 /// @param absent The value when the key is absent.
476 /// @return Its value; @p absent when the key is absent.
477 [[nodiscard]] bool flag(std::string_view key, bool absent) const {
478 auto const found = flags.find(key);
479 return found == flags.end() ? absent : found->second;
480 }
481};

521/// @brief What a load-time warning is about. A warning never refuses a document.
522enum class LoadWarningKind : std::uint8_t {
523 WatchFeedback, ///< A watch of a query runs a mutation that changes data, on any change of it.
524 Uncovered, ///< A mutation whose action declares nothing, and after which nothing refreshes.
525};
526
527/// @brief A finding of load-time validation that does not refuse the document.
528struct LoadWarning {
529 /// @brief What it is about.
530 LoadWarningKind kind = LoadWarningKind::Uncovered;
531 /// @brief The JSON Pointer of the declaration it names.
532 std::string path;
533 /// @brief The finding, in one sentence.
534 std::string text;
535
536 /// @brief The warning as one line of text.
537 /// @param document The id of the document it was found in; empty leaves it out.
538 /// @return `document <id> at <path>: <text>`, leaving out the parts that are empty.
539 [[nodiscard]] std::string message(std::string_view document) const {
540 std::string out;
541 if (!document.empty()) {
542 out += "document " + std::string{document} + " ";
543 }
544 out += "at " + (path.empty() ? std::string{"/"} : path) + ": " + text;
545 return out;
546 }
547};

566/// @brief A loaded and validated UI document: a screen, or the app document (id `app`, spec 6 §5).
567struct Document {
568 /// @brief The vocabulary, `ui/1`.
569 std::string vocab;
570 /// @brief The document id, such as `lims.results`.
571 std::string id;
572 /// @brief The title expression.
573 ExprPtr title;
574 /// @brief The identity expression: equal identities are one screen.
575 ExprPtr identity;
576 /// @brief The unsaved-changes expression.
577 ExprPtr dirty;
578 /// @brief The title as runs, drawn in place of `title` in a shell's top bar by a client that knows it; `nullptr`
579 /// when none is declared.
580 ExprPtr titleSpans;
581 /// @brief The eyebrow expression of the screen's head, the line above the title; `nullptr` when none is declared.
582 ExprPtr eyebrow;
583 /// @brief The eyebrow as runs, drawn in place of `eyebrow` by a client that knows it; `nullptr` when none is
584 /// declared.
585 ExprPtr eyebrowSpans;
586 /// @brief The subtitle expression of the screen's head; `nullptr` when none is declared.
587 ExprPtr subtitle;
588 /// @brief The subtitle as runs, drawn in place of `subtitle` by a client that knows it; `nullptr` when none is
589 /// declared.
590 ExprPtr subtitleSpans;
591 /// @brief Where the head's lead (subtitle and badges) sits: an expression of `below`, `inline` or `end`;
592 /// `nullptr` when none is declared, which is `below`.
593 ExprPtr leadPlacement;
594 /// @brief The text role of the head's title: an expression of `heading` or `headline`; `nullptr` when none is
595 /// declared, which is `heading`.
596 ExprPtr titleRole;
597 /// @brief The surface the shell draws the top bar on while the screen is shown: an expression of a surface's
598 /// name; `nullptr` when none is declared.
599 ExprPtr headSurface;
600 /// @brief The surface the shell draws the page area on while the screen is shown: an expression of a surface's
601 /// name; `nullptr` when none is declared, which is the built-in `page` surface.
602 ExprPtr pageSurface;
603 /// @brief The app document's principal placement, `sidebar` or `head`; empty for the default, `sidebar`.
604 std::string principalPlacement;
605 /// @brief The head's status badges: `headBadge` parts, in order.
606 std::vector<DocNodePtr> status;
607 /// @brief The head's actions: `actionButton` parts, in order.
608 std::vector<DocNodePtr> actions;
609 /// @brief The head's own menu: `headMenuItem` parts, in order.
610 std::vector<DocNodePtr> menu;
611 /// @brief The accessible name of the head menu's trigger; `nullptr` for the default, "More actions".
612 ExprPtr menuLabel;
613 /// @brief The head's tools: `headTool` parts, a search field or a select each, in order.
614 std::vector<DocNodePtr> tools;
615 /// @brief The app document's counts on the navigator's entries: `navigationBadge` parts, in order; empty for a
616 /// screen, which declares none.
617 std::vector<DocNodePtr> navigation;
618 /// @brief The typed params, in declaration order.
619 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, Type>> params;
620 /// @brief The screen scope's declarations.
621 ScopeDecl scope;
622 /// @brief The lifecycle command lists by key: `onMount`, `onUnmount`, `onClose`, `onSave`, `onBackendChange`.
623 std::map<std::string, Commands, std::less<>> lifecycle;
624 /// @brief The screen's key bindings.
625 std::map<std::string, Commands, std::less<>> keys;
626 /// @brief When errors show: `touched`, `submit` or `always`; empty for the default.
627 std::string showErrors;
628 /// @brief The app document's date pattern (`formatting.date`), which `mountApp` gives the session; empty keeps
629 /// ISO, and a screen has none.
630 std::string datePattern;
631 /// @brief The app document's date-and-time pattern (`formatting.dateTime`), as `datePattern`.
632 std::string dateTimePattern;
633 /// @brief Queries started before the screen mounts.
634 std::vector<std::string> prefetch;
635 /// @brief Custom components, by name.
636 std::map<std::string, Component, std::less<>> components;
637 /// @brief Customization points, by name.
638 std::map<std::string, CustomizePoint, std::less<>> customize;
639 /// @brief The view; `nullptr` for the app document.
640 DocNodePtr view;
641 /// @brief The static type of each `dateTimeInput`'s `value` that the loader could decide: `String` or
642 /// `Timestamp`, keyed by the node. A node whose value type is `any` or `key` has no entry.
643 std::map<DocNode const*, TypeKind> dateValueKinds;
644 /// @brief Each `focus` command's resolved target, keyed by the command's JSON Pointer.
645 std::map<std::string, FocusTarget, std::less<>> focusTargets;
646 /// @brief What load-time validation found that does not refuse the document, in the order found. Empty when
647 /// the catalog answers no actions.
648 std::vector<LoadWarning> warnings;
649};

651namespace detail {
652
653/// @brief The exception the loader throws inside itself; `loadDocument` turns it into its result.
654class DocumentRefused : public std::runtime_error {
655public:
656 /// @brief Wraps a refusal.
657 /// @param refusal The refusal.
658 explicit DocumentRefused(Refusal refusal) : std::runtime_error{refusal.reason}, _refusal{std::move(refusal)} {}
659
660 /// @brief The refusal.
661 /// @return It.
662 [[nodiscard]] Refusal const& refusal() const noexcept { return _refusal; }
663
664private:
665 Refusal _refusal;
666};
667
668/// @brief Refuses the document.
669/// @param path Where.
670/// @param reason Why.
671[[noreturn]] inline void refuse(std::string const& path, std::string reason) {
672 throw DocumentRefused{Refusal{.document = {}, .path = path, .reason = std::move(reason)}};
673}
674
675/// @brief What shape a node key's value takes.
676enum class Shape : std::uint8_t {
677 Expr, ///< An expression.
678 Condition, ///< An expression checked as a `bool`.
679 Commands, ///< A command list.
680 Nodes, ///< A node or a list of nodes.
681 Text, ///< A plain string.
682 Name, ///< A plain string that is a name.
683 Part, ///< A record, parsed by the part table of its part kind.
684 Parts, ///< A list of such records.
685 PartsOrExpr, ///< A list of records, or an expression yielding one.
686 ExprRecord, ///< A record of expressions.
687 CommandRecord, ///< A record of command lists.
688 Keys, ///< Key bindings: chord to command list.
689 Flag, ///< A literal `true` or `false`, set once.
690};
691
692/// @brief The key is evaluated in the node's own scope (a dialog's, a row's), not the scope around it.
693inline constexpr std::uint8_t kInner = 1U;
694/// @brief The key is required.
695inline constexpr std::uint8_t kRequired = 2U;
696/// @brief The key's content is a boundary's `error`, where `boundary.error` and `retry` are valid.
697inline constexpr std::uint8_t kBoundaryError = 4U;
698
699/// @brief One key of a kind.
700struct KeySpec {
701 /// @brief The key.
702 std::string_view key;
703 /// @brief Its shape.
704 Shape shape;
705 /// @brief The part kind, for `Part`, `Parts` and `PartsOrExpr`.
706 std::string_view part = {}; // NOLINT(readability-redundant-member-init): table rows leave it out
707 /// @brief `kInner`, `kRequired`, `kBoundaryError`.
708 std::uint8_t flags = 0;
709};
710
711/// @brief The node or part creates a scope.
712inline constexpr std::uint8_t kScope = 1U;
713/// @brief The scope it creates is a row scope, where `row` is valid. On a part without `kScope`, the part's inner keys
714/// are read in a row scope of their own that declares nothing: a chart series' per-point keys.
715inline constexpr std::uint8_t kRowScope = 2U;
716/// @brief It carries the input decorations `readonly`, `required`, `errors` and `stale`.
717inline constexpr std::uint8_t kField = 4U;
718/// @brief It is a part, not a node: it has no common properties.
719inline constexpr std::uint8_t kPart = 8U;
720/// @brief A command may write its draft with `set`.
721inline constexpr std::uint8_t kWritable = 16U;
722/// @brief Any path below its id is an element value (a form's fields).
723inline constexpr std::uint8_t kOpenValues = 32U;
724
725/// @brief A node kind or part kind: its keys and its element values.
726struct KindSpec {
727 /// @brief The kind.
728 std::string_view kind;
729 /// @brief Its own keys.
730 std::span<KeySpec const> keys;
731 /// @brief `kScope`, `kRowScope`, `kField`, `kPart`, `kWritable`, `kOpenValues`.
732 std::uint8_t flags = 0;
733 /// @brief The element values beyond those every element has.
734 std::span<std::string_view const> values = {}; // NOLINT(readability-redundant-member-init): rows leave it out
735};
736
737// NOLINTBEGIN(modernize-use-designated-initializers): the kind table reads as rows; names on every field would not.

1215/// @brief Looks up a node kind or a part kind.
1216/// @param kind The kind.
1217/// @param part Whether a part kind is wanted.
1218/// @return The spec, or `nullptr`.
1219[[nodiscard]] inline KindSpec const* findKind(std::string_view kind, bool part) {
1220 for (KindSpec const& spec : kKinds) {
1221 if (spec.kind == kind && ((spec.flags & kPart) != 0) == part) {
1222 return &spec;
1223 }
1224 }
1225 return nullptr;
1226}

1228/// @brief Whether a list of names holds one.
1229/// @param names The list.
1230/// @param name The candidate.
1231/// @return Whether @p name is in @p names.
1232[[nodiscard]] inline bool listed(std::span<std::string_view const> names, std::string_view name) {
1233 return std::ranges::find(names, name) != names.end();
1234}
1235
1236/// @brief Refuses a must-understand key (`!name`) the client does not know; other unknown keys are ignored.
1237/// @param object The JSON object.
1238/// @param path Its JSON Pointer.
1239inline void refuseMustUnderstand(Json::object_t const& object, std::string const& path) {
1240 for (auto const& [key, value] : object) {
1241 static_cast<void>(value);
1242 if (key.starts_with('!')) {
1243 refuse(pointerAppend(path, key), "the must-understand key `" + key + "` is not part of ui/1");
1244 }
1245 }
1246}
1247
1248/// @brief Parses a key chord, and refuses one the workspace shell reserves.
1249/// @param chord The chord, such as `Ctrl+Shift+K`.
1250/// @param path Its JSON Pointer.
1251// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a chord's grammar, modifiers then one key name.
1252inline void checkChord(std::string const& chord, std::string const& path) {
1253 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kModifiers = {"Ctrl", "Shift", "Alt", "Meta"};
1254 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 9> kNamedKeys = {"Enter", "Esc", "Tab", "Up", "Down",
1255 "Left", "Right", "Space", "Delete"};
1256 std::vector<std::string_view> parts;
1257 std::size_t start = 0;
1258 for (std::size_t plus = chord.find('+'); plus != std::string::npos; plus = chord.find('+', start)) {
1259 parts.push_back(std::string_view{chord}.substr(start, plus - start));
1260 start = plus + 1;
1261 }
1262 std::string_view const key = std::string_view{chord}.substr(start);
1263 std::set<std::string_view> modifiers;
1264 for (std::string_view const modifier : parts) {
1265 if (!listed(kModifiers, modifier) || !modifiers.insert(modifier).second) {
1266 refuse(path, "`" + chord + "` is not a chord: modifiers are Ctrl, Shift, Alt and Meta, once each");
1267 }
1268 }
1269 bool const letterOrDigit =
1270 key.size() == 1 && ((key.front() >= 'A' && key.front() <= 'Z') || (key.front() >= 'a' && key.front() <= 'z') ||
1271 (key.front() >= '0' && key.front() <= '9'));
1272 bool function = key.size() >= 2 && key.size() <= 3 && key.front() == 'F';
1273 int number = 0;
1274 for (char const chr : key.substr(function ? 1 : key.size())) {
1275 function = function && chr >= '0' && chr <= '9';
1276 number = (number * 10) + (chr - '0');
1277 }
1278 function = function && number >= 1 && number <= 24;
1279 if (!letterOrDigit && !function && !listed(kNamedKeys, key)) {
1280 refuse(path, "`" + chord + "` does not end in a key name");
1281 }
1282 bool const ctrlOnly = modifiers.size() == 1 && modifiers.contains("Ctrl");
1283 bool const ctrlShift = modifiers.size() == 2 && modifiers.contains("Ctrl") && modifiers.contains("Shift");
1284 bool const reserved = (key == "Tab" && (ctrlOnly || ctrlShift)) ||
1285 (ctrlOnly && (key == "W" || key == "w" || key == "K" || key == "k"));
1286 if (reserved) {
1287 refuse(path, "`" + chord + "` is reserved for the workspace shell");
1288 }
1289}
1290
1291// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a document is a tree of nodes and command lists, and parsing descends it.
1292/// @brief Turns the JSON of a document into its model, refusing what does not parse.
1293class DocumentParser {
1294public:
1295 /// @brief Parses the whole document.
1296 /// @param json The document.
1297 /// @return The model, not yet checked against its names.
1298 [[nodiscard]] Document parse(Json const& json) {
1299 auto const* const object = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&json.data);
1300 if (object == nullptr) {
1301 refuse("", "a document is a JSON object");
1302 }
1303 refuseMustUnderstand(*object, "");
1304 Document doc;
1305 doc.vocab = text(*object, "vocab", "", true);
1306 if (doc.vocab != kVocabulary) {
1307 refuse("/vocab", "the vocabulary `" + doc.vocab + "` is not supported; this client reads ui/1");
1308 }
1309 doc.id = text(*object, "id", "", true);
1310 if (doc.id.empty()) {
1311 refuse("/id", "a document has a non-empty id");
1312 }
1313 doc.title = optionalExpr(*object, "title", "");
1314 doc.identity = optionalExpr(*object, "identity", "");
1315 doc.dirty = optionalExpr(*object, "dirty", "");
1316 doc.titleSpans = optionalExpr(*object, "titleSpans", "");
1317 doc.eyebrow = optionalExpr(*object, "eyebrow", "");
1318 doc.eyebrowSpans = optionalExpr(*object, "eyebrowSpans", "");
1319 doc.subtitle = optionalExpr(*object, "subtitle", "");
1320 doc.subtitleSpans = optionalExpr(*object, "subtitleSpans", "");
1321 doc.leadPlacement = optionalExpr(*object, "leadPlacement", "");
1322 checkLeadPlacementLiteral(doc.leadPlacement);
1323 doc.titleRole = optionalExpr(*object, "titleRole", "");
1324 checkTitleRoleLiteral(doc.titleRole);
1325 doc.headSurface = optionalExpr(*object, "headSurface", "");
1326 doc.pageSurface = optionalExpr(*object, "pageSurface", "");
1327 doc.status = topParts(*object, "status", "headBadge");
1328 doc.actions = topParts(*object, "actions", "actionButton");
1329 doc.menu = topParts(*object, "menu", "headMenuItem");
1330 doc.menuLabel = optionalExpr(*object, "menuLabel", "");
1331 doc.tools = topParts(*object, "tools", "headTool");
1332 doc.navigation = navigation(*object, doc.id);
1333 if (doc.id == "app") {
1334 refuseScreenHead(*object);
1335 }
1336 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kPrincipalPlacements = {"sidebar", "head"};
1337 doc.principalPlacement = choiceOf(*object, "principalPlacement", "", kPrincipalPlacements);
1338 if (doc.id != "app" && member(*object, "principalPlacement") != nullptr) {
1339 refuse("/principalPlacement", "`principalPlacement` is the app document's; a screen has none");
1340 }
1341 doc.showErrors = showErrors(*object, "");
1342 datePatterns(*object, doc);
1343 if (Json const* const params = member(*object, "params")) {
1344 for (auto const& [name, type] : objectOf(*params, "/params", "`params` maps names to types")) {
1345 std::string const path = pointerAppend("/params", name);
1346 checkName(name, path);
1347 doc.params.emplace_back(name, typeOf(type, path));
1348 }
1349 }
1350 doc.scope = scope(*object, "");
1351 for (std::string_view const key : {"onMount", "onUnmount", "onClose", "onSave", "onBackendChange"}) {
1352 if (Json const* const commands = member(*object, key)) {
1353 doc.lifecycle.emplace(std::string{key}, commandList(*commands, pointerAppend("", key)));
1354 }
1355 }
1356 if (Json const* const keys = member(*object, "keys")) {
1357 doc.keys = keyBindings(*keys, "/keys");
1358 }
1359 if (Json const* const prefetch = member(*object, "prefetch")) {
1360 doc.prefetch = nameList(*prefetch, "/prefetch");
1361 }
1362 if (Json const* const components = member(*object, "components")) {
1363 for (auto const& [name, entry] : objectOf(*components, "/components", "`components` is an object")) {
1364 doc.components.emplace(name, component(name, entry, pointerAppend("/components", name)));
1365 }
1366 }
1367 if (Json const* const points = member(*object, "customize")) {
1368 for (auto const& [name, entry] : objectOf(*points, "/customize", "`customize` is an object")) {
1369 doc.customize.emplace(name, point(name, entry, pointerAppend("/customize", name), doc.id == "app"));
1370 }
1371 }
1372 if (Json const* const view = member(*object, "view")) {
1373 doc.view = node(*view, "/view");
1374 } else if (doc.id != "app") {
1375 refuse("", "a screen has a `view`");
1376 }
1377 return doc;
1378 }
1379
1380private:
1381 // The app document's `formatting`: a record of the date pattern and the date-and-time pattern, each checked.
1382 static void datePatterns(Json::object_t const& object, Document& doc) {
1383 Json const* const formatting = member(object, "formatting");
1384 if (formatting == nullptr) {
1385 return;
1386 }
1387 if (doc.id != "app") {
1388 refuse("/formatting", "`formatting` is the application's; only the app document declares it");
1389 }
1390 for (auto const& [key, value] : objectOf(*formatting, "/formatting", "`formatting` is a record")) {
1391 std::string const path = pointerAppend("/formatting", key);
1392 if (key != "date" && key != "dateTime") {
1393 refuse(path, "`formatting` takes `date` and `dateTime`");
1394 }
1395 std::string const* const pattern = std::get_if<std::string>(&value.data);
1396 if (pattern == nullptr) {
1397 refuse(path, "a date pattern is a string, such as `dd-MMM-yyyy`");
1398 }
1399 if (auto const checked = checkDatePattern(*pattern, key == "dateTime"); !checked) {
1400 refuse(path, checked.error());
1401 }
1402 (key == "date" ? doc.datePattern : doc.dateTimePattern) = *pattern;
1403 }
1404 }
1405
1406 [[nodiscard]] static Json const* member(Json::object_t const& object, std::string_view key) {
1407 auto const* const found = object.find(key);
1408 return found == object.end() ? nullptr : &found->second;
1409 }
1410
1411 [[nodiscard]] static Json::object_t const& objectOf(Json const& json, std::string const& path, char const* what) {
1412 auto const* const object = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&json.data);
1413 if (object == nullptr) {
1414 refuse(path, what);
1415 }
1416 return *object;
1417 }
1418
1419 static void checkName(std::string const& name, std::string const& path) {
1420 if (!isName(name)) {
1421 refuse(path, "`" + name + "` is not a name: names match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*");
1422 }
1423 }
1424
1425 [[nodiscard]] static std::string text(Json::object_t const& object, std::string_view key, std::string const& path,
1426 bool required) {
1427 Json const* const value = member(object, key);
1428 std::string const keyPath = pointerAppend(path, key);
1429 if (value == nullptr) {
1430 if (required) {
1431 refuse(path, "`" + std::string{key} + "` is required");
1432 }
1433 return {};
1434 }
1435 auto const* const string = std::get_if<std::string>(&value->data);
1436 if (string == nullptr) {
1437 refuse(keyPath, "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a string");
1438 }
1439 return *string;
1440 }
1441
1442 [[nodiscard]] static std::string choiceOf(Json::object_t const& object, std::string_view key,
1443 std::string const& path, std::span<std::string_view const> choices) {
1444 std::string value = text(object, key, path, false);
1445 if (!value.empty() && !listed(choices, value)) {
1446 refuse(pointerAppend(path, key), "`" + value + "` is not one of the values of `" + std::string{key} + "`");
1447 }
1448 return value;
1449 }
1450
1451 [[nodiscard]] static std::string showErrors(Json::object_t const& object, std::string const& path) {
1452 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kPolicies = {"touched", "submit", "always"};
1453 return choiceOf(object, "showErrors", path, kPolicies);
1454 }
1455
1456 [[nodiscard]] static std::int64_t integer(Json::object_t const& object, std::string_view key,
1457 std::string const& path) {
1458 Json const* const value = member(object, key);
1459 if (value == nullptr) {
1460 return 0;
1461 }
1462 auto const number = detail::jsonInt(*value);
1463 if (!number || *number < 0) {
1464 refuse(pointerAppend(path, key), "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a non-negative integer");
1465 }
1466 return *number;
1467 }
1468
1469 [[nodiscard]] static bool flag(Json::object_t const& object, std::string_view key, std::string const& path) {
1470 Json const* const value = member(object, key);
1471 if (value == nullptr) {
1472 return false;
1473 }
1474 bool const* const set = std::get_if<bool>(&value->data);
1475 if (set == nullptr) {
1476 refuse(pointerAppend(path, key), "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a bool");
1477 }
1478 return *set;
1479 }
1480
1481 [[nodiscard]] static Type typeOf(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1482 auto const* const spelled = std::get_if<std::string>(&json.data);
1483 if (spelled == nullptr) {
1484 refuse(path, "a type is written as a string, such as `int?`");
1485 }
1486 auto type = parseType(*spelled);
1487 if (!type) {
1488 refuse(path, type.error());
1489 }
1490 return *type;
1491 }
1492
1493 [[nodiscard]] static std::vector<std::string> nameList(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1494 auto const* const array = std::get_if<Json::array_t>(&json.data);
1495 if (array == nullptr) {
1496 refuse(path, "a list of names is an array of strings");
1497 }
1498 std::vector<std::string> names;
1499 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < array->size(); ++index) {
1500 auto const* const name = std::get_if<std::string>(&array->at(index).data);
1501 if (name == nullptr || name->empty()) {
1502 refuse(pointerAppend(path, index), "a list of names is an array of strings");
1503 }
1504 names.push_back(*name);
1505 }
1506 return names;
1507 }
1508
1509 [[nodiscard]] static ExprPtr expr(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1510 auto parsed = parseExpression(json, path);
1511 if (!parsed) {
1512 throw DocumentRefused{std::move(parsed.error())};
1513 }
1514 return std::move(*parsed);
1515 }
1516
1517 [[nodiscard]] static ExprPtr optionalExpr(Json::object_t const& object, std::string_view key,
1518 std::string const& path) {
1519 Json const* const value = member(object, key);
1520 return value == nullptr ? nullptr : expr(*value, pointerAppend(path, key));
1521 }
1522
1523 // The head belongs to a screen's tab; the app document has no view and so no head.
1524 static void refuseScreenHead(Json::object_t const& object) {
1525 for (std::string_view const key :
1526 {"titleSpans", "eyebrow", "eyebrowSpans", "subtitle", "subtitleSpans", "leadPlacement", "titleRole",
1527 "headSurface", "pageSurface", "status", "actions", "menu", "menuLabel", "tools"}) {
1528 if (member(object, key) != nullptr) {
1529 refuse(pointerAppend("", key), "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a screen's; the app document has none");
1530 }
1531 }
1532 }
1533
1534 // A `leadPlacement` written as a literal is one of the three places; a computed one is read at run time.
1535 static void checkLeadPlacementLiteral(ExprPtr const& placement) {
1536 if (placement == nullptr || placement->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
1537 return;
1538 }
1539 std::string const* const name = placement->literal.asString();
1540 if (name == nullptr || (*name != "below" && *name != "inline" && *name != "end")) {
1541 refuse(placement->path, "`leadPlacement` is `below`, `inline` or `end`");
1542 }
1543 }
1544
1545 // A `titleRole` written as a literal is one of the two roles a head's title takes; a computed one is read at run
1546 // time.
1547 static void checkTitleRoleLiteral(ExprPtr const& role) {
1548 if (role == nullptr || role->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
1549 return;
1550 }
1551 std::string const* const name = role->literal.asString();
1552 if (name == nullptr || (*name != "heading" && *name != "headline")) {
1553 refuse(role->path, "`titleRole` is `heading` or `headline`");
1554 }
1555 }
1556
1557 // The app document's `navigation` badges, each naming its screen; a screen declares none.
1558 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<DocNodePtr> navigation(Json::object_t const& object, std::string_view documentId) {
1559 std::vector<DocNodePtr> badges = topParts(object, "navigation", "navigationBadge");
1560 if (documentId != "app" && !badges.empty()) {
1561 refuse("/navigation", "`navigation` is the app document's; a screen has none");
1562 }
1563 for (DocNodePtr const& badge : badges) {
1564 if (badge->name("screen").empty()) {
1565 refuse(pointerAppend(badge->path, "screen"), "a navigation badge names the screen of its entry");
1566 }
1567 }
1568 return badges;
1569 }
1570
1571 // A top-level list of parts: the screen head's `status` and `actions`.
1572 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): the document key, then its part kind, at every call.
1573 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<DocNodePtr> topParts(Json::object_t const& object, std::string_view key,
1574 std::string_view kind) {
1575 std::vector<DocNodePtr> parts;
1576 Json const* const value = member(object, key);
1577 if (value == nullptr) {
1578 return parts;
1579 }
1580 std::string const path = pointerAppend("", key);
1581 auto const* const array = std::get_if<Json::array_t>(&value->data);
1582 if (array == nullptr) {
1583 refuse(path, "`" + std::string{key} + "` is an array");
1584 }
1585 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < array->size(); ++index) {
1586 parts.push_back(part(array->at(index), kind, pointerAppend(path, index)));
1587 }
1588 return parts;
1589 }
1590
1591 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per kind of declaration.
1592 [[nodiscard]] ScopeDecl scope(Json::object_t const& object, std::string const& path) {
1593 ScopeDecl decl;
1594 if (Json const* const models = member(object, "models")) {
1595 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "models");
1596 for (auto const& [name, entry] : objectOf(*models, where, "`models` maps aliases to models")) {
1597 decl.models.push_back(model(name, entry, pointerAppend(where, name)));
1598 }
1599 }
1600 if (Json const* const state = member(object, "state")) {
1601 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "state");
1602 for (auto const& [name, entry] : objectOf(*state, where, "`state` maps names to declarations")) {
1603 std::string const entryPath = pointerAppend(where, name);
1604 checkName(name, entryPath);
1605 auto const& fields = objectOf(entry, entryPath, R"(a state declaration is {"init": e, "type": T})");
1606 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, entryPath);
1607 StateDecl stateDecl{
1608 .name = name, .path = entryPath, .type = Type::any(), .typeDeclared = false, .init = nullptr};
1609 if (Json const* const type = member(fields, "type")) {
1610 stateDecl.type = typeOf(*type, pointerAppend(entryPath, "type"));
1611 stateDecl.typeDeclared = true;
1612 }
1613 stateDecl.init = optionalExpr(fields, "init", entryPath);
1614 decl.state.push_back(std::move(stateDecl));
1615 }
1616 }
1617 if (Json const* const lets = member(object, "let")) {
1618 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "let");
1619 for (auto const& [name, entry] : objectOf(*lets, where, "`let` maps names to expressions")) {
1620 std::string const entryPath = pointerAppend(where, name);
1621 checkName(name, entryPath);
1622 decl.lets.push_back(LetDecl{.name = name, .path = entryPath, .value = expr(entry, entryPath)});
1623 }
1624 }
1625 if (Json const* const queries = member(object, "queries")) {
1626 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "queries");
1627 for (auto const& [name, entry] : objectOf(*queries, where, "`queries` maps names to queries")) {
1628 decl.queries.push_back(query(name, entry, pointerAppend(where, name)));
1629 }
1630 }
1631 if (Json const* const mutations = member(object, "mutations")) {
1632 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "mutations");
1633 for (auto const& [name, entry] : objectOf(*mutations, where, "`mutations` maps names to mutations")) {
1634 decl.mutations.push_back(mutation(name, entry, pointerAppend(where, name)));
1635 }
1636 }
1637 if (Json const* const watches = member(object, "watch")) {
1638 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "watch");
1639 auto const* const array = std::get_if<Json::array_t>(&watches->data);
1640 if (array == nullptr) {
1641 refuse(where, "`watch` is an array");
1642 }
1643 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < array->size(); ++index) {
1644 decl.watches.push_back(watch(array->at(index), pointerAppend(where, index)));
1645 }
1646 }
1647 if (Json const* const checks = member(object, "checks")) {
1648 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "checks");
1649 auto const* const array = std::get_if<Json::array_t>(&checks->data);
1650 if (array == nullptr) {
1651 refuse(where, "`checks` is an array");
1652 }
1653 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < array->size(); ++index) {
1654 decl.checks.push_back(check(array->at(index), pointerAppend(where, index)));
1655 }
1656 }
1657 return decl;
1658 }
1659
1660 [[nodiscard]] static ModelDecl model(std::string const& name, Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1661 checkName(name, path);
1662 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, R"(a model alias is {"type": ..., "instance": ...})");
1663 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
1664 ModelDecl decl{.name = name,
1665 .path = path,
1666 .type = text(fields, "type", path, true),
1667 .instance = {},
1668 .key = nullptr,
1669 .borrowedFrom = {}};
1670 Json const* const instance = member(fields, "instance");
1671 if (instance == nullptr) {
1672 return decl;
1673 }
1674 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "instance");
1675 auto const* const word = std::get_if<std::string>(&instance->data);
1676 if (word != nullptr && (*word == "private" || *word == "shared")) {
1677 decl.instance = *word == "private" ? InstanceMode::Private : InstanceMode::Shared;
1678 return decl;
1679 }
1680 if (auto const* const object = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&instance->data)) {
1681 if (Json const* const from = member(*object, "from")) {
1682 auto const* const alias = std::get_if<std::string>(&from->data);
1683 if (alias == nullptr || !isName(*alias) || object->size() != 1) {
1684 refuse(where, R"(a borrowed instance is {"from": alias})");
1685 }
1686 decl.instance = InstanceMode::Borrowed;
1687 decl.borrowedFrom = *alias;
1688 return decl;
1689 }
1690 }
1691 decl.instance = InstanceMode::Keyed;
1692 decl.key = expr(*instance, where);
1693 return decl;
1694 }
1695
1696 /// @brief Refuses @p key of @p fields: a refresh key, which a document does not declare.
1697 /// @param fields The declaration's fields.
1698 /// @param path The declaration's JSON Pointer.
1699 /// @param key The refresh key: `invalidates`, `patch` or `refreshOn`.
1700 static void refuseRefreshKey(Json::object_t const& fields, std::string const& path, std::string_view key) {
1701 if (member(fields, key) != nullptr) {
1702 refuse(pointerAppend(path, key),
1703 std::format("a document does not declare `{}`: an action's effects say what it changes, and every "
1704 "query holding a changed record refreshes; a refresh no action declares is a `refetch` "
1705 "command",
1706 key));
1707 }
1708 }
1709
1710 [[nodiscard]] static QueryDecl query(std::string const& name, Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1711 checkName(name, path);
1712 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, "a query is an object");
1713 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
1714 QueryDecl decl;
1715 decl.name = name;
1716 decl.path = path;
1717 decl.model = text(fields, "model", path, true);
1718 std::string const action = text(fields, "action", path, false);
1719 std::string const evaluate = text(fields, "evaluate", path, false);
1720 if (action.empty() == evaluate.empty()) {
1721 refuse(path, "a query names exactly one of `action` and `evaluate`");
1722 }
1723 decl.action = action.empty() ? evaluate : action;
1724 decl.evaluate = !evaluate.empty();
1725 decl.body = optionalExpr(fields, "body", path);
1726 decl.when = optionalExpr(fields, "when", path);
1727 decl.debounce = integer(fields, "debounce", path);
1728 decl.refreshEvery = integer(fields, "refreshEvery", path);
1729 decl.staleTime = integer(fields, "staleTime", path);
1730 refuseRefreshKey(fields, path, "refreshOn");
1731 return decl;
1732 }
1733
1734 /// @brief Parses an `optimistic` write: `{"query": q, "at"?: m, "key": e, "with": e}`.
1735 /// @param json The write's JSON.
1736 /// @param path Its JSON Pointer.
1737 /// @return The write.
1738 [[nodiscard]] static OptimisticDecl optimistic(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1739 static constexpr char const* shape = R"(an optimistic write is {"query": q, "at"?: m, "key": e, "with": e})";
1740 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, shape);
1741 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
1742 Json const* const key = member(fields, "key");
1743 Json const* const with = member(fields, "with");
1744 if (key == nullptr || with == nullptr) {
1745 refuse(path, shape);
1746 }
1747 std::string listMember = text(fields, "at", path, false);
1748 if (member(fields, "at") != nullptr && listMember.empty()) {
1749 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "at"), "`at` names the member of the query's record that holds the list");
1750 }
1751 return OptimisticDecl{.query = text(fields, "query", path, true),
1752 .at = std::move(listMember),
1753 .key = expr(*key, pointerAppend(path, "key")),
1754 .with = expr(*with, pointerAppend(path, "with"))};
1755 }
1756
1757 [[nodiscard]] MutationDecl mutation(std::string const& name, Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1758 checkName(name, path);
1759 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, "a mutation is an object");
1760 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
1761 MutationDecl decl;
1762 decl.name = name;
1763 decl.path = path;
1764 decl.model = text(fields, "model", path, true);
1765 decl.action = text(fields, "action", path, true);
1766 decl.body = optionalExpr(fields, "body", path);
1767 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kModes = {"exclusive", "serial", "latest", "parallel"};
1768 std::string const mode = choiceOf(fields, "concurrency", path, kModes);
1769 if (mode == "serial") {
1770 decl.concurrency = Concurrency::Serial;
1771 } else if (mode == "latest") {
1772 decl.concurrency = Concurrency::Latest;
1773 } else if (mode == "parallel") {
1774 decl.concurrency = Concurrency::Parallel;
1775 }
1776 decl.serialKey = optionalExpr(fields, "serialKey", path);
1777 if (decl.serialKey && decl.concurrency != Concurrency::Serial) {
1778 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "serialKey"), "`serialKey` applies to `serial` concurrency only");
1779 }
1780 refuseRefreshKey(fields, path, "invalidates");
1781 refuseRefreshKey(fields, path, "patch");
1782 if (Json const* const value = member(fields, "optimistic")) {
1783 decl.optimistic = optimistic(*value, pointerAppend(path, "optimistic"));
1784 }
1785 if (Json const* const commands = member(fields, "onSuccess")) {
1786 decl.onSuccess = commandList(*commands, pointerAppend(path, "onSuccess"));
1787 }
1788 if (Json const* const commands = member(fields, "onError")) {
1789 decl.onError = commandList(*commands, pointerAppend(path, "onError"));
1790 }
1791 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 1> kOffline = {"queue"};
1792 decl.offlineQueue = !choiceOf(fields, "offline", path, kOffline).empty();
1793 return decl;
1794 }
1795
1796 [[nodiscard]] WatchDecl watch(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1797 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, R"(a watch is {"on": e, "do": [...]})");
1798 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
1799 Json const* const watched = member(fields, "on");
1800 Json const* const body = member(fields, "do");
1801 if (watched == nullptr || body == nullptr) {
1802 refuse(path, R"(a watch is {"on": e, "do": [...]})");
1803 }
1804 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kSources = {"any", "user"};
1805 return WatchDecl{
1806 .path = path,
1807 .on = expr(*watched, pointerAppend(path, "on")),
1808 .source = choiceOf(fields, "source", path, kSources) == "user" ? WatchSource::User : WatchSource::Any,
1809 .body = commandList(*body, pointerAppend(path, "do"))};
1810 }
1811
1812 [[nodiscard]] static CheckDecl check(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1813 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, R"(a check is {"id": ..., "assert": e, ...})");
1814 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
1815 Json const* const assertion = member(fields, "assert");
1816 if (assertion == nullptr) {
1817 refuse(path, "a check has an `assert`");
1818 }
1819 CheckDecl decl;
1820 decl.id = text(fields, "id", path, false);
1821 decl.path = path;
1822 decl.assertion = expr(*assertion, pointerAppend(path, "assert"));
1823 decl.message = optionalExpr(fields, "message", path);
1824 if (Json const* const targets = member(fields, "targets")) {
1825 decl.targets = nameList(*targets, pointerAppend(path, "targets"));
1826 }
1827 decl.blocking = flag(fields, "blocking", path);
1828 return decl;
1829 }
1830
1831 struct CommandSpec {
1832 std::string_view key;
1833 CommandKind kind;
1834 std::array<std::string_view, 6> companions;
1835 };
1836
1837 // NOLINTBEGIN(modernize-use-designated-initializers): one row per command reads as a table.
1838 static constexpr std::array<CommandSpec, 23> kCommands = {{
1839 {"set", CommandKind::Set, {"value"}},
1840 {"reset", CommandKind::Reset, {}},
1841 {"run", CommandKind::Run, {"body", "as", "each"}},
1842 {"refetch", CommandKind::Refetch, {}},
1843 {"open", CommandKind::Open, {}},
1844 {"close", CommandKind::Close, {}},
1845 {"navigate", CommandKind::Navigate, {"params", "as", "onResult", "onCancel"}},
1846 {"return", CommandKind::Return, {}},
1847 {"focus", CommandKind::Focus, {"row"}},
1848 {"host", CommandKind::Host, {"args"}},
1849 {"switchBackend", CommandKind::SwitchBackend, {}},
1850 {"resetPrefs", CommandKind::ResetPrefs, {}},
1851 {"setLocale", CommandKind::SetLocale, {}},
1852 {"notify", CommandKind::Notify, {"role"}},
1853 {"seq", CommandKind::Seq, {}},
1854 {"all", CommandKind::All, {}},
1855 {"if", CommandKind::If, {}},
1856 {"cancelClose", CommandKind::CancelClose, {}},
1857 {"retry", CommandKind::Retry, {}},
1858 {"signIn", CommandKind::SignIn, {}},
1859 {"signOut", CommandKind::SignOut, {}},
1860 {"upload", CommandKind::Upload, {"to", "as", "id", "into", "nameAs", "typeAs"}},
1861 {"download", CommandKind::Download, {"save", "name", "to", "as", "from", "type"}},
1862 }};
1863 // NOLINTEND(modernize-use-designated-initializers)
1864
1865 [[nodiscard]] Commands commandList(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1866 Commands commands;
1867 if (auto const* const array = std::get_if<Json::array_t>(&json.data)) {
1868 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < array->size(); ++index) {
1869 commands.push_back(command(array->at(index), pointerAppend(path, index)));
1870 }
1871 return commands;
1872 }
1873 commands.push_back(command(json, path));
1874 return commands;
1875 }
1876
1877 [[nodiscard]] static std::string nameOf(Json const& json, std::string const& path, char const* what,
1878 bool dotted = false) {
1879 auto const* const name = std::get_if<std::string>(&json.data);
1880 bool valid = name != nullptr && !name->empty();
1881 if (valid && dotted) {
1882 auto const segments = splitPath(*name);
1883 valid = segments.has_value() && isName(segments->front());
1884 } else if (valid) {
1885 valid = isName(*name);
1886 }
1887 if (!valid) {
1888 refuse(path, what);
1889 }
1890 return *name;
1891 }
1892
1893 [[nodiscard]] static std::string nonEmpty(Json const& json, std::string const& path, char const* what) {
1894 auto const* const name = std::get_if<std::string>(&json.data);
1895 if (name == nullptr || name->empty()) {
1896 refuse(path, what);
1897 }
1898 return *name;
1899 }
1900
1901 static void requireTrue(Json const& json, std::string const& path, std::string_view key) {
1902 bool const* const value = std::get_if<bool>(&json.data);
1903 if (value == nullptr || !*value) {
1904 refuse(path, "`" + std::string{key} + "` is written `true`");
1905 }
1906 }
1907
1908 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per command of ui/1.
1909 [[nodiscard]] Command command(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
1910 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, R"(a command is an object such as {"set": ..., "value": ...})");
1911 CommandSpec const* chosen = nullptr;
1912 for (auto const& [key, value] : fields) {
1913 static_cast<void>(value);
1914 for (CommandSpec const& spec : kCommands) {
1915 if (spec.key == key) {
1916 if (chosen != nullptr) {
1917 refuse(path,
1918 "a command has one kind; found `" + std::string{chosen->key} + "` and `" + key + "`");
1919 }
1920 chosen = &spec;
1921 }
1922 }
1923 }
1924 if (chosen == nullptr) {
1925 refuse(path, "not a command of ui/1");
1926 }
1927 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
1928 Command cmd;
1929 cmd.kind = chosen->kind;
1930 cmd.path = path;
1931 Json const& primary = *member(fields, chosen->key);
1932 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, chosen->key);
1933 switch (chosen->kind) {
1934 case CommandKind::Set: {
1935 cmd.target = nameOf(primary, where, "`set` names state or an element as `name.path`", true);
1936 Json const* const value = member(fields, "value");
1937 if (value == nullptr) {
1938 refuse(path, "`set` needs a `value`");
1939 }
1940 cmd.value = expr(*value, pointerAppend(path, "value"));
1941 break;
1942 }
1943 case CommandKind::Run:
1944 cmd.target = nameOf(primary, where, "`run` names a mutation");
1945 cmd.value = optionalExpr(fields, "body", path);
1946 cmd.extra = optionalExpr(fields, "each", path);
1947 if (Json const* const binding = member(fields, "as")) {
1948 cmd.binding = nameOf(*binding, pointerAppend(path, "as"), "`as` is a name");
1949 }
1950 break;
1951 case CommandKind::Reset:
1952 case CommandKind::Refetch:
1953 case CommandKind::Open:
1954 cmd.target = nameOf(primary, where, "the command names a declaration or an element");
1955 break;
1956 case CommandKind::Focus:
1957 cmd.target = nameOf(primary, where, "the command names a declaration or an element");
1958 cmd.extra = optionalExpr(fields, "row", path);
1959 break;
1960 case CommandKind::Close:
1961 cmd.target = nameOf(primary, where, "`close` names a dialog, or `self`");
1962 break;
1963 case CommandKind::Navigate:
1964 navigate(cmd, fields, primary, path);
1965 break;
1966 case CommandKind::Return:
1967 cmd.value = expr(primary, where);
1968 break;
1969 case CommandKind::Host:
1970 cmd.target = nonEmpty(primary, where, "`host` names a registered command");
1971 cmd.value = optionalExpr(fields, "args", path);
1972 break;
1973 case CommandKind::SwitchBackend:
1974 case CommandKind::SetLocale:
1975 cmd.target = nonEmpty(primary, where, "the command takes a non-empty string");
1976 break;
1977 case CommandKind::ResetPrefs:
1978 cmd.target = nameOf(primary, where, "`resetPrefs` names a customization point, or `all`");
1979 break;
1980 case CommandKind::Notify: {
1981 cmd.value = expr(primary, where);
1982 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kRoles = {"info", "success", "warning", "error"};
1983 cmd.option = choiceOf(fields, "role", path, kRoles);
1984 break;
1985 }
1986 case CommandKind::Seq:
1987 case CommandKind::All: {
1988 if (!std::holds_alternative<Json::array_t>(primary.data)) {
1989 refuse(where, "`" + std::string{chosen->key} + "` takes an array of commands");
1990 }
1991 cmd.commands = commandList(primary, where);
1992 break;
1993 }
1994 case CommandKind::If: {
1995 auto const* const array = std::get_if<Json::array_t>(&primary.data);
1996 if (array == nullptr || array->size() < 2 || array->size() > 3) {
1997 refuse(where, "`if` takes [condition, [then...], [else...]]");
1998 }
1999 cmd.value = expr(array->at(0), pointerAppend(where, std::size_t{0}));
2000 cmd.commands = commandList(array->at(1), pointerAppend(where, 1));
2001 if (array->size() == 3) {
2002 cmd.alternative = commandList(array->at(2), pointerAppend(where, 2));
2003 }
2004 break;
2005 }
2006 case CommandKind::CancelClose:
2007 case CommandKind::Retry:
2008 case CommandKind::SignOut:
2009 requireTrue(primary, where, chosen->key);
2010 break;
2011 case CommandKind::SignIn: {
2012 auto const* const object = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&primary.data);
2013 Json const* const from = object == nullptr ? nullptr : member(*object, "from");
2014 if (from == nullptr) {
2015 refuse(where, R"(`signIn` is {"from": mutation})");
2016 }
2017 cmd.target = nameOf(*from, pointerAppend(where, "from"), "`signIn` names its mutation");
2018 break;
2019 }
2020 case CommandKind::Upload: {
2021 cmd.value = expr(primary, where);
2022 Json const* const destination = member(fields, "to");
2023 if (destination == nullptr) {
2024 refuse(path, "`upload` names its mutation with `to`");
2025 }
2026 cmd.target = nameOf(*destination, pointerAppend(path, "to"), "`to` names a mutation");
2027 if (Json const* const binding = member(fields, "as")) {
2028 cmd.binding = nameOf(*binding, pointerAppend(path, "as"), "`as` is a name");
2029 }
2030 if (Json const* const transfer = member(fields, "id")) {
2031 cmd.transfer = nameOf(*transfer, pointerAppend(path, "id"), "`id` is a name");
2032 }
2033 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kInto = {"ref", "bytes"};
2034 cmd.bytes = choiceOf(fields, "into", path, kInto) == "bytes";
2035 for (auto const& [key, slot] : {std::pair{"nameAs", &cmd.nameAs}, std::pair{"typeAs", &cmd.typeAs}}) {
2036 if (Json const* const name = member(fields, key)) {
2037 if (!cmd.bytes) {
2038 refuse(pointerAppend(path, key),
2039 "`" + std::string{key} +
2040 R"(` names a body member for inline bytes; give `"into": "bytes"`)");
2041 }
2042 *slot = nameOf(*name, pointerAppend(path, key), "a body member is a name");
2043 }
2044 }
2045 break;
2046 }
2047 case CommandKind::Download:
2048 default:
2049 download(cmd, fields, primary, path);
2050 break;
2051 }
2052 return cmd;
2053 }
2054
2055 void navigate(Command& cmd, Json::object_t const& fields, Json const& primary, std::string const& path) {
2056 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "navigate");
2057 if (auto const* const route = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&primary.data)) {
2058 Json const* const value = member(*route, "route");
2059 if (value == nullptr || route->size() != 1) {
2060 refuse(where, R"(`navigate` names a screen, or is {"route": e})");
2061 }
2062 cmd.extra = expr(*value, pointerAppend(where, "route"));
2063 } else {
2064 cmd.target = nonEmpty(primary, where, R"(`navigate` names a screen, or is {"route": e})");
2065 }
2066 cmd.value = optionalExpr(fields, "params", path);
2067 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kModes = {"tab", "dialog", "drawer", "window"};
2068 cmd.option = choiceOf(fields, "as", path, kModes);
2069 if (Json const* const result = member(fields, "onResult")) {
2070 cmd.commands = commandList(*result, pointerAppend(path, "onResult"));
2071 }
2072 if (Json const* const cancel = member(fields, "onCancel")) {
2073 cmd.alternative = commandList(*cancel, pointerAppend(path, "onCancel"));
2074 }
2075 }
2076
2077 static void download(Command& cmd, Json::object_t const& fields, Json const& primary, std::string const& path) {
2078 cmd.value = expr(primary, pointerAppend(path, "download"));
2079 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kFrom = {"ref", "bytes"};
2080 cmd.bytes = choiceOf(fields, "from", path, kFrom) == "bytes";
2081 if (cmd.bytes) {
2082 // Inline bytes carry no name or type of their own, so the document gives the name.
2083 if (member(fields, "name") == nullptr) {
2084 refuse(path, "a download from bytes names its file with `name`");
2085 }
2086 cmd.extra = optionalExpr(fields, "name", path);
2087 cmd.mediaType = optionalExpr(fields, "type", path);
2088 } else if (member(fields, "type") != nullptr) {
2089 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "type"), R"(`type` is the media type of inline bytes; give `"from": "bytes"`)");
2090 }
2091 std::string const save = text(fields, "save", path, false);
2092 std::string const destination = text(fields, "to", path, false);
2093 if (save == "dialog" && destination.empty()) {
2094 cmd.option = "dialog";
2095 cmd.extra = optionalExpr(fields, "name", path);
2096 return;
2097 }
2098 if (destination == "preview" && save.empty()) {
2099 Json const* const binding = member(fields, "as");
2100 if (binding == nullptr) {
2101 refuse(path, "a download to preview binds a state with `as`");
2102 }
2103 cmd.option = "preview";
2104 cmd.target = nameOf(*binding, pointerAppend(path, "as"), "`as` names a state");
2105 return;
2106 }
2107 refuse(path, R"(`download` takes `"save": "dialog"` or `"to": "preview"`)");
2108 }
2109
2110 [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, Commands, std::less<>> keyBindings(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
2111 std::map<std::string, Commands, std::less<>> keys;
2112 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : objectOf(json, path, "`keys` maps chords to commands")) {
2113 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, chord);
2114 checkChord(chord, where);
2115 keys.emplace(chord, commandList(commands, where));
2116 }
2117 return keys;
2118 }
2119
2120 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a component's rules, one after another.
2121 [[nodiscard]] Component component(std::string const& name, Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
2122 checkName(name, path);
2123 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, "a component is an object");
2124 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
2125 Component decl;
2126 decl.name = name;
2127 decl.path = path;
2128 decl.qml = text(fields, "qml", path, false);
2129 decl.host = text(fields, "host", path, false);
2130 if (decl.qml.empty() == decl.host.empty()) {
2131 refuse(path, "a component names exactly one of `qml` and `host`");
2132 }
2133 if (!decl.qml.empty()) {
2134 bool hash = decl.qml.size() == 71 && decl.qml.starts_with("sha256:");
2135 for (char const chr : std::string_view{decl.qml}.substr(std::min<std::size_t>(7, decl.qml.size()))) {
2136 hash = hash && ((chr >= '0' && chr <= '9') || (chr >= 'a' && chr <= 'f'));
2137 }
2138 if (!hash) {
2139 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "qml"), "`qml` is a content hash `sha256:<64 hex digits>`");
2140 }
2141 } else {
2142 Json const* const version = member(fields, "version");
2143 auto const number = version == nullptr ? std::nullopt : detail::jsonInt(*version);
2144 if (!number) {
2145 refuse(path, "a host component has an integer `version`");
2146 }
2147 decl.version = *number;
2148 }
2149 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 6> kPropTypes = {"string", "bool", "int",
2150 "exact", "number", "json"};
2151 if (Json const* const props = member(fields, "props")) {
2152 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "props");
2153 for (auto const& [prop, type] : objectOf(*props, where, "`props` maps names to prop types")) {
2154 auto const* const spelled = std::get_if<std::string>(&type.data);
2155 if (spelled == nullptr || !listed(kPropTypes, *spelled)) {
2156 refuse(pointerAppend(where, prop), "a prop type is string, bool, int, exact, number or json");
2157 }
2158 decl.props.emplace(prop, *spelled);
2159 }
2160 }
2161 if (Json const* const events = member(fields, "events")) {
2162 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "events");
2163 for (auto const& [event, type] : objectOf(*events, where, "`events` maps names to payload types")) {
2164 decl.events.emplace(event, typeOf(type, pointerAppend(where, event)));
2165 }
2166 }
2167 Json const* const fallback = member(fields, "fallback");
2168 if (fallback == nullptr) {
2169 refuse(path, "a component names a `fallback` of built-in nodes");
2170 }
2171 decl.fallback = node(*fallback, pointerAppend(path, "fallback"));
2172 return decl;
2173 }
2174
2175 [[nodiscard]] static CustomizePoint point(std::string const& name, Json const& json, std::string const& path,
2176 bool appDocument) {
2177 checkName(name, path);
2178 auto const& fields = objectOf(json, path, "a customization point is an object");
2179 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, path);
2180 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 7> kPointKinds = {"columns", "choice", "value", "layout",
2181 "saved", "pins", "arrange"};
2182 CustomizePoint decl;
2183 decl.name = name;
2184 decl.path = path;
2185 decl.kind = text(fields, "kind", path, true);
2186 if (!listed(kPointKinds, decl.kind)) {
2187 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "kind"), "`" + decl.kind + "` is not a kind of customization point");
2188 }
2189 if (decl.kind == "pins" && !appDocument) {
2190 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "kind"), "a `pins` point belongs to the app document");
2191 }
2192 // The container an `arrange` point orders is a screen's, and the app document has no view.
2193 if (decl.kind == "arrange" && appDocument) {
2194 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "kind"), "an `arrange` point belongs to the screen whose container it orders");
2195 }
2196 decl.of = text(fields, "of", path, decl.kind == "columns" || decl.kind == "arrange");
2197 Json const* const fallback = member(fields, "default");
2198 if (decl.kind == "choice") {
2199 Json const* const options = member(fields, "options");
2200 if (options == nullptr) {
2201 refuse(path, "a `choice` point lists its `options`");
2202 }
2203 decl.options = nameList(*options, pointerAppend(path, "options"));
2204 if (fallback != nullptr) {
2205 auto const* const chosen = std::get_if<std::string>(&fallback->data);
2206 if (chosen == nullptr || std::ranges::find(decl.options, *chosen) == decl.options.end()) {
2207 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "default"), "the default of a `choice` is one of its options");
2208 }
2209 decl.defaultValue = *chosen;
2210 }
2211 decl.type = Type::of(TypeKind::String);
2212 } else if (decl.kind == "value") {
2213 Json const* const type = member(fields, "type");
2214 if (type == nullptr) {
2215 refuse(path, "a `value` point declares its `type`");
2216 }
2217 decl.type = typeOf(*type, pointerAppend(path, "type"));
2218 if (fallback != nullptr) {
2219 auto value = valueFromJson(*fallback, decl.type);
2220 if (!value) {
2221 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "default"),
2222 "the default does not have the point's type: " + value.error());
2223 }
2224 decl.defaultValue = std::move(*value);
2225 }
2226 }
2227 return decl;
2228 }
2229
2230 [[nodiscard]] DocNodePtr node(Json const& json, std::string const& path) {
2231 auto const* const object = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&json.data);
2232 if (object == nullptr) {
2233 refuse(path, "a node is an object with a `kind`");
2234 }
2235 std::string const kind = text(*object, "kind", path, true);
2236 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(kind, false);
2237 if (spec == nullptr) {
2238 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "kind"), "the node kind `" + kind + "` is not in ui/1");
2239 }
2240 auto made = std::make_shared<DocNode>();
2241 made->kind = kind;
2242 made->path = path;
2243 refuseMustUnderstand(*object, path);
2244 fill(*made, *object, *spec, path);
2245 return made;
2246 }
2247
2248 void fill(DocNode& made, Json::object_t const& object, KindSpec const& spec, std::string const& path) {
2249 bool const isPart = (spec.flags & kPart) != 0;
2250 auto apply = [&](KeySpec const& key) {
2251 Json const* const value = member(object, key.key);
2252 if (value == nullptr) {
2253 if ((key.flags & kRequired) != 0) {
2254 refuse(path, "`" + std::string{key.key} + "` is required on `" + std::string{spec.kind} + "`");
2255 }
2256 return;
2257 }
2258 entry(made, key, *value, pointerAppend(path, key.key));
2259 };
2260 if (!isPart) {
2261 for (KeySpec const& key : kCommonKeys) {
2262 apply(key);
2263 }
2264 if ((spec.flags & kField) != 0) {
2265 for (KeySpec const& key : kFieldKeys) {
2266 apply(key);
2267 }
2268 }
2269 }
2270 for (KeySpec const& key : spec.keys) {
2271 apply(key);
2272 }
2273 if ((spec.flags & kScope) != 0) {
2274 if (Json const* const declarations = member(object, "scope")) {
2275 std::string const where = pointerAppend(path, "scope");
2276 auto const& fields = objectOf(*declarations, where, "`scope` holds a scope's declarations");
2277 refuseMustUnderstand(fields, where);
2278 made.scope = scope(fields, where);
2279 } else {
2280 made.scope = ScopeDecl{};
2281 }
2282 }
2283 if (made.kind == "fields") {
2284 for (auto const& [field, overlay] : object) {
2285 made.parts["fields"].push_back(fieldOverlay(field, overlay, pointerAppend(path, field)));
2286 }
2287 }
2288 }
2289
2290 // One field overlay of a form's `fields`: expressions by key, and the host `component` that draws the field with
2291 // its `props`.
2292 [[nodiscard]] static DocNodePtr fieldOverlay(std::string const& field, Json const& overlay,
2293 std::string const& where) {
2294 auto const& settings = objectOf(overlay, where, "a field overlay is an object");
2295 auto part = std::make_shared<DocNode>();
2296 part->kind = "field";
2297 part->id = field;
2298 part->path = where;
2299 for (auto const& [key, value] : settings) {
2300 std::string const keyPath = pointerAppend(where, key);
2301 if (key == "component") {
2302 // The host component that draws the field, and the props it is given beside the field's.
2303 auto const* const name = std::get_if<std::string>(&value.data);
2304 if (name == nullptr || !isName(*name)) {
2305 refuse(keyPath, "`component` is a name");
2306 }
2307 part->names.emplace(key, *name);
2308 } else if (key == "props") {
2309 auto record = std::make_shared<DocNode>();
2310 record->kind = "props";
2311 record->path = keyPath;
2312 for (auto const& [prop, propValue] : objectOf(value, keyPath, "`props` is a record of expressions")) {
2313 record->props.emplace(prop, expr(propValue, pointerAppend(keyPath, prop)));
2314 }
2315 part->parts["props"].push_back(std::move(record));
2316 } else {
2317 part->props.emplace(key, expr(value, keyPath));
2318 }
2319 }
2320 return part;
2321 }
2322
2323 [[nodiscard]] DocNodePtr part(Json const& json, std::string_view kind, std::string const& path) {
2324 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(kind, true);
2325 auto const& object = objectOf(json, path, "a part of a node is an object");
2326 refuseMustUnderstand(object, path);
2327 auto made = std::make_shared<DocNode>();
2328 made->kind = std::string{kind};
2329 made->path = path;
2330 fill(*made, object, *spec, path);
2331 if (kind == "actionButton" && made->prop("iconOnly") != nullptr && made->prop("icon") == nullptr) {
2332 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "iconOnly"), "an icon-only action names its `icon`");
2333 }
2334 return made;
2335 }
2336
2337 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per shape a key takes.
2338 void entry(DocNode& made, KeySpec const& key, Json const& value, std::string const& path) {
2339 std::string const name{key.key};
2340 switch (key.shape) {
2341 case Shape::Expr:
2342 case Shape::Condition:
2343 made.props.emplace(name, expr(value, path));
2344 break;
2345 case Shape::Commands:
2346 made.events.emplace(name, commandList(value, path));
2347 break;
2348 case Shape::Nodes: {
2349 std::vector<DocNodePtr> nodes;
2350 if (auto const* const array = std::get_if<Json::array_t>(&value.data)) {
2351 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < array->size(); ++index) {
2352 nodes.push_back(node(array->at(index), pointerAppend(path, index)));
2353 }
2354 } else {
2355 nodes.push_back(node(value, path));
2356 }
2357 made.children.emplace(name, std::move(nodes));
2358 break;
2359 }
2360 case Shape::Text:
2361 case Shape::Name: {
2362 auto const* const string = std::get_if<std::string>(&value.data);
2363 if (string == nullptr || (key.shape == Shape::Name && !isName(*string))) {
2364 refuse(path, "`" + name + "` is " + (key.shape == Shape::Name ? "a name" : "a string"));
2365 }
2366 if (name == "id") {
2367 made.id = *string;
2368 } else {
2369 made.names.emplace(name, *string);
2370 }
2371 break;
2372 }
2373 case Shape::Part:
2374 made.parts[name].push_back(part(value, key.part, path));
2375 break;
2376 case Shape::Parts:
2377 case Shape::PartsOrExpr: {
2378 auto const* const array = std::get_if<Json::array_t>(&value.data);
2379 if (array == nullptr && key.shape == Shape::PartsOrExpr) {
2380 made.props.emplace(name, expr(value, path));
2381 break;
2382 }
2383 if (array == nullptr) {
2384 refuse(path, "`" + name + "` is an array");
2385 }
2386 auto& list = made.parts[name];
2387 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < array->size(); ++index) {
2388 list.push_back(part(array->at(index), key.part, pointerAppend(path, index)));
2389 }
2390 break;
2391 }
2392 case Shape::ExprRecord: {
2393 if (!key.part.empty()) {
2394 made.parts[name].push_back(part(value, key.part, path));
2395 break;
2396 }
2397 auto record = std::make_shared<DocNode>();
2398 record->kind = name;
2399 record->path = path;
2400 for (auto const& [field, fieldValue] : objectOf(value, path, "a record of expressions")) {
2401 record->props.emplace(field, expr(fieldValue, pointerAppend(path, field)));
2402 }
2403 made.parts[name].push_back(std::move(record));
2404 break;
2405 }
2406 case Shape::CommandRecord:
2407 for (auto const& [event, commands] : objectOf(value, path, "a record of command lists")) {
2408 made.events.emplace(std::format("{}.{}", name, event),
2409 commandList(commands, pointerAppend(path, event)));
2410 }
2411 break;
2412 case Shape::Flag: {
2413 auto const* const flag = std::get_if<bool>(&value.data);
2414 if (flag == nullptr) {
2415 refuse(path, "`" + name + "` is a literal `true` or `false`");
2416 }
2417 made.flags.emplace(name, *flag);
2418 break;
2419 }
2420 case Shape::Keys:
2421 default:
2422 made.keys = keyBindings(value, path);
2423 break;
2424 }
2425 }
2426 // NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
2427};
2428
2429/// @brief What a name in a scope declares.
2430enum class NameCategory : std::uint8_t {
2431 Param, ///< A screen param.
2432 Model, ///< A model alias.
2433 State, ///< State.
2434 Let, ///< A derived value.
2435 Query, ///< A query.
2436 Mutation, ///< A mutation.
2437 Element, ///< An element id.
2438 Transfer, ///< A transfer id of `upload`.
2439};
2440
2441struct ScopeInfo;
2442
2443/// @brief One declared name of a scope.
2444struct NameEntry {
2445 /// @brief What it declares.
2446 NameCategory category = NameCategory::Param;
2447 /// @brief The declaration's JSON Pointer.
2448 std::string path;
2449 /// @brief The scope that declares it.
2450 ScopeInfo* scope = nullptr;
2451 /// @brief The type of a param, of typed state, and of state or a `let` once derived.
2452 Type type;
2453 /// @brief The model of a `Model` entry.
2454 ModelDecl const* model = nullptr;
2455 /// @brief The expression a state or `let` type is derived from; `nullptr` when the type is declared.
2456 ExprPtr derivedFrom;
2457 /// @brief The query of a `Query` entry.
2458 QueryDecl const* query = nullptr;
2459 /// @brief The mutation of a `Mutation` entry.
2460 MutationDecl const* mutation = nullptr;
2461 /// @brief The element of an `Element` entry.
2462 DocNode const* element = nullptr;
2463 /// @brief 0 before its type is derived, 1 while it is, 2 after.
2464 int visit = 0;
2465};
2466
2467/// @brief One scope during validation: its names and its parent.
2468struct ScopeInfo {
2469 /// @brief The enclosing scope; `nullptr` for a screen or a component fallback.
2470 ScopeInfo* parent = nullptr;
2471 /// @brief The scopes it encloses directly, in document order.
2472 std::vector<ScopeInfo*> children;
2473 /// @brief Whether it is a `forEach` or `table` row scope.
2474 bool row = false;
2475 /// @brief The `switch` whose case it is; `nullptr` for any other scope.
2476 DocNode const* switchNode = nullptr;
2477 /// @brief Whether it is the screen's own scope.
2478 bool screen = false;
2479 /// @brief The names it declares.
2480 std::map<std::string, NameEntry, std::less<>> names;
2481};
2482
2483/// @brief Where an expression or command is checked: its scope and what is valid there.
2484struct CheckContext {
2485 /// @brief The scope.
2486 ScopeInfo* scope = nullptr;
2487 /// @brief Inside a command list, where `event` is valid.
2488 bool commands = false;
2489 /// @brief Inside a boundary's `error`, where `boundary.error` and `retry` are valid.
2490 bool boundaryError = false;
2491 /// @brief Inside `onClose`, where `cancelClose` is valid.
2492 bool onClose = false;
2493 /// @brief Names bound here: `as` of a sequence step or `each`, `result`, `body`, `props`.
2494 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, Type>> bindings;
2495};
2496
2497class DocumentValidator;
2498
