2499/// @brief Resolves an expression's names against a scope chain and a context.
2500class ScopeResolver final : public NameResolver {
2501public:
2502 /// @brief Resolves for @p validator in @p context.
2503 /// @param validator The validator, which derives state and `let` types on demand.
2504 /// @param context Where the expression is.
2505 ScopeResolver(DocumentValidator& validator, CheckContext const& context)
2506 : _validator{validator}, _context{context} {}
2507
2508 /// @brief Resolves a reference.
2509 /// @param head The first segment.
2510 /// @param path The rest.
2511 /// @return The type, or why it does not resolve.
2512 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<Type, std::string> ref(std::string_view head,
2513 std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
2514
2515 /// @brief Resolves a row field.
2516 /// @param path The field path.
2517 /// @return `any` inside a row, or why there is no row.
2518 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<Type, std::string> row(std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
2519
2520 /// @brief Resolves a query or mutation name.
2521 /// @param form The form.
2522 /// @param name The name.
2523 /// @return The type, or why it does not resolve.
2524 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<Type, std::string> control(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const override;
2525
2526 /// @brief Resolves a customization point.
2527 /// @param point The point.
2528 /// @param path The rest.
2529 /// @return The type, or why it does not resolve.
2530 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<Type, std::string> pref(std::string_view point,
2531 std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
2532
2533private:
2534 DocumentValidator& _validator;
2535 CheckContext const& _context;
2536};
2537
2538/// @brief The type of an element value.
2539/// @param value The value's name.
2540/// @return Its type.
2541[[nodiscard]] inline Type elementValueType(std::string_view value) {
2542 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 10> kBools = {"visible", "enabled", "valid", "dirty", "focused",
2543 "touched", "checked", "open", "ready", "submitted"};
2544 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kCounts = {"viewCount", "sourceCount", "selectedCount"};
2545 if (listed(kBools, value) || value == "pending") {
2546 return Type::of(TypeKind::Bool);
2547 }
2548 if (value == "errors" || value == "shownErrors") {
2549 return Type::listOf(Type::of(TypeKind::String));
2550 }
2551 if (listed(kCounts, value)) {
2552 return Type::of(TypeKind::Int);
2553 }
2554 if (value == "error") {
2555 return Type::of(TypeKind::String, true);
2556 }
2557 return Type::any();
2558}
2559
2560/// @brief Whether a value of type @p actual may stand where @p declared is expected.
2561/// @param declared The expected type.
2562/// @param actual The type found.
2563/// @return Whether they are compatible: equal kinds, `any` on either side, an `int` for a `decimal` or `key`, a
2564/// `string` for a `key`.
2565[[nodiscard]] inline bool compatible(Type const& declared, Type const& actual) {
2566 if (declared.isAny() || actual.isAny() || declared.kind == actual.kind) {
2567 return true;
2568 }
2569 bool const integer = actual.kind == TypeKind::Int;
2570 return (declared.kind == TypeKind::Decimal && integer) ||
2571 (declared.kind == TypeKind::Key && (integer || actual.kind == TypeKind::String));
2572}
2573
2574// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a document is a tree of scopes, nodes and command lists, and checking descends it.
2575/// @brief Checks a parsed document against its own names and the catalog: every load-time rule that needs more
2576/// than one place in the document.
2577class DocumentValidator {
2578public:
2579 /// @brief Validates @p doc.
2580 /// @param doc The parsed document.
2581 /// @param options The catalog facts.
2582 DocumentValidator(Document const& doc, LoadOptions const& options) : _doc{&doc}, _options{&options} {}
2583
2584 /// @brief Runs every rule; throws `DocumentRefused` on the first refusal.
2585 void run() {
2586 ScopeInfo& screen = newScope(nullptr, false);
2587 screen.screen = true;
2588 for (auto const& [name, type] : _doc->params) {
2589 NameEntry entry;
2590 entry.category = NameCategory::Param;
2591 entry.path = pointerAppend("/params", name);
2592 entry.type = type;
2593 add(screen, name, std::move(entry));
2594 }
2595 declare(_doc->scope, screen);
2596 for (auto const& [key, commands] : _doc->lifecycle) {
2597 static_cast<void>(key);
2598 collectTransfers(commands, screen);
2599 }
2600 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : _doc->keys) {
2601 static_cast<void>(chord);
2602 collectTransfers(commands, screen);
2603 }
2604 if (_doc->view) {
2605 collect(*_doc->view, screen);
2606 }
2607 for (DocNodePtr const& part : headParts()) {
2608 collectPart(*part, screen, screen, *part);
2609 }
2610 std::vector<ScopeInfo*> componentScopes;
2611 for (auto const& [name, component] : _doc->components) {
2612 static_cast<void>(name);
2613 ScopeInfo& fallbackScope = newScope(nullptr, false);
2614 collect(*component.fallback, fallbackScope);
2615 componentScopes.push_back(&fallbackScope);
2616 }
2617
2618 CheckContext const root{
2619 .scope = &screen, .commands = false, .boundaryError = false, .onClose = false, .bindings = {}};
2620 checkScope(_doc->scope, root);
2621 if (_doc->title) {
2622 checkExpr(*_doc->title, root);
2623 }
2624 if (_doc->identity) {
2625 checkExpr(*_doc->identity, root);
2626 }
2627 if (_doc->dirty) {
2628 checkCondition(*_doc->dirty, root, "`dirty`");
2629 }
2630 if (_doc->titleSpans) {
2631 checkExpr(*_doc->titleSpans, root);
2632 checkSpans(_doc->titleSpans);
2633 }
2634 if (_doc->eyebrow) {
2635 checkExpr(*_doc->eyebrow, root);
2636 }
2637 if (_doc->eyebrowSpans) {
2638 checkExpr(*_doc->eyebrowSpans, root);
2639 checkSpans(_doc->eyebrowSpans);
2640 }
2641 if (_doc->subtitle) {
2642 checkExpr(*_doc->subtitle, root);
2643 }
2644 if (_doc->subtitleSpans) {
2645 checkExpr(*_doc->subtitleSpans, root);
2646 checkSpans(_doc->subtitleSpans);
2647 }
2648 if (_doc->leadPlacement) {
2649 checkExpr(*_doc->leadPlacement, root);
2650 }
2651 if (_doc->titleRole) {
2652 checkExpr(*_doc->titleRole, root);
2653 }
2654 if (_doc->headSurface) {
2655 checkExpr(*_doc->headSurface, root);
2656 }
2657 if (_doc->pageSurface) {
2658 checkExpr(*_doc->pageSurface, root);
2659 }
2660 if (_doc->menuLabel) {
2661 checkExpr(*_doc->menuLabel, root);
2662 }
2663 for (DocNodePtr const& part : headParts()) {
2664 checkElement(*part, root, true);
2665 }
2666 checkActionButtons(_doc->actions, "/actions");
2667 std::set<std::string_view> menuIds;
2668 checkHeadMenu(_doc->menu, menuIds);
2669 checkHeadTools(_doc->tools);
2670 for (auto const& [key, commands] : _doc->lifecycle) {
2671 CheckContext context = root;
2672 context.onClose = key == "onClose";
2673 checkCommands(commands, context);
2674 }
2675 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : _doc->keys) {
2676 static_cast<void>(chord);
2677 checkCommands(commands, root);
2678 }
2679 checkPrefetch();
2680 if (_doc->view) {
2681 checkNode(*_doc->view, root);
2682 }
2683 std::size_t index = 0;
2684 for (auto const& [name, component] : _doc->components) {
2685 static_cast<void>(name);
2686 CheckContext context{.scope = componentScopes.at(index++),
2687 .commands = false,
2688 .boundaryError = false,
2689 .onClose = false,
2690 .bindings = {}};
2691 context.bindings.emplace_back("props", Type::of(TypeKind::Record));
2692 checkNode(*component.fallback, context);
2693 }
2694 checkCustomizePoints();
2695 checkWatchGraph();
2696 checkEffects();
2697 }
2698
2699 /// @brief What validation found that does not refuse the document.
2700 /// @return The warnings, in the order found; the validator keeps none.
2701 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<LoadWarning> takeWarnings() noexcept { return std::move(_warnings); }
2702
2703 /// @brief The static type of each date input's `value` that the checker could decide.
2704 /// @return The table, keyed by node; the validator keeps none.
2705 [[nodiscard]] std::map<DocNode const*, TypeKind> takeDateValueKinds() noexcept {
2706 return std::move(_dateValueKinds);
2707 }
2708
2709 /// @brief Where each `focus` command's target resolved, keyed by the command's JSON Pointer.
2710 /// @return The table; the validator keeps none.
2711 [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, FocusTarget, std::less<>> takeFocusTargets() noexcept {
2712 return std::move(_focusTargets);
2713 }
2714
2715 /// @brief Finds a name in a scope chain.
2716 /// @param scope The innermost scope.
2717 /// @param name The name.
2718 /// @return The entry, or `nullptr`.
2719 [[nodiscard]] static NameEntry* lookup(ScopeInfo* scope, std::string_view name) {
2720 for (ScopeInfo* current = scope; current != nullptr; current = current->parent) {
2721 auto const found = current->names.find(name);
2722 if (found != current->names.end()) {
2723 return &found->second;
2724 }
2725 }
2726 return nullptr;
2727 }
2728
2729 /// @brief The type of a name whose type is derived from an expression, derived on first use.
2730 /// @param entry The state or `let` entry.
2731 /// @param name Its name, for the cycle's description.
2732 /// @return The type, or the cycle it closes.
2733 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<Type, std::string> derivedType(NameEntry& entry, std::string_view name) {
2734 if (entry.visit == 2 || !entry.derivedFrom) {
2735 return entry.type;
2736 }
2737 if (entry.visit == 1) {
2738 std::string cycle;
2739 auto const start = std::ranges::find(_deriving, name);
2740 for (auto step = start; step != _deriving.end(); ++step) {
2741 cycle += *step + " → ";
2742 }
2743 std::string const graph =
2744 entry.category == NameCategory::Let ? "the let graph has a cycle: " : "the state inits form a cycle: ";
2745 return std::unexpected(graph + cycle + std::string{name});
2746 }
2747 entry.visit = 1;
2748 _deriving.emplace_back(name);
2749 CheckContext const context{
2750 .scope = entry.scope, .commands = false, .boundaryError = false, .onClose = false, .bindings = {}};
2751 Type type = checkExpr(*entry.derivedFrom, context);
2752 _deriving.pop_back();
2753 entry.visit = 2;
2754 entry.type = type;
2755 return type;
2756 }
2757
2758 /// @brief The document.
2759 /// @return It.
2760 [[nodiscard]] Document const& document() const noexcept { return *_doc; }
2761
2762private:
2763 ScopeInfo& newScope(ScopeInfo* parent, bool row) {
2764 ScopeInfo& made = _scopes.emplace_back();
2765 made.parent = parent;
2766 made.row = row;
2767 if (parent != nullptr) {
2768 parent->children.push_back(&made);
2769 }
2770 return made;
2771 }
2772
2773 static void add(ScopeInfo& scope, std::string const& name, NameEntry entry) {
2774 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 6> kReserved = {"event", "app", "boundary",
2775 "props", "result", "body"};
2776 if (listed(kReserved, name)) {
2777 refuse(entry.path, "`" + name + "` is reserved and cannot be declared");
2778 }
2779 auto const found = scope.names.find(name);
2780 if (found != scope.names.end()) {
2781 refuse(entry.path, "`" + name + "` is declared twice in this scope (first at " + found->second.path + ")");
2782 }
2783 entry.scope = &scope;
2784 scope.names.emplace(name, std::move(entry));
2785 }
2786
2787 /// Checks a model alias against the catalog's facts, when there is a catalog.
2788 void checkCatalog(ModelDecl const& model) {
2789 if (!_options->catalog.model) {
2790 return;
2791 }
2792 auto const info = _options->catalog.model(model.type);
2793 if (!info) {
2794 refuse(pointerAppend(model.path, "type"), "the model type `" + model.type + "` is not in the catalog");
2795 }
2796 if (model.instance == InstanceMode::Shared && !info->stateless) {
2797 refuse(pointerAppend(model.path, "instance"),
2798 "the model type `" + model.type +
2799 "` keeps state, so `shared` names no instance: it needs a key, or `private`");
2800 }
2801 if (model.instance == InstanceMode::Keyed && !info->keyed) {
2802 refuse(pointerAppend(model.path, "instance"),
2803 "the model type `" + model.type + "` is not keyed, so its instance is not an expression");
2804 }
2805 }
2806
2807 void declare(ScopeDecl const& decl, ScopeInfo& scope) {
2808 for (ModelDecl const& model : decl.models) {
2809 if (scope.row && model.instance == InstanceMode::Default) {
2810 refuse(model.path, "a model alias in a row scope names its `instance`");
2811 }
2812 if (!scope.screen && model.instance == InstanceMode::Borrowed) {
2813 refuse(model.path, "only a screen's own aliases borrow the opener's instance");
2814 }
2815 checkCatalog(model);
2816 NameEntry entry;
2817 entry.category = NameCategory::Model;
2818 entry.path = model.path;
2819 entry.model = &model;
2820 add(scope, model.name, std::move(entry));
2821 }
2822 for (StateDecl const& state : decl.state) {
2823 NameEntry entry;
2824 entry.category = NameCategory::State;
2825 entry.path = state.path;
2826 entry.type = state.type;
2827 entry.derivedFrom = state.typeDeclared ? nullptr : state.init;
2828 add(scope, state.name, std::move(entry));
2829 }
2830 for (LetDecl const& let : decl.lets) {
2831 NameEntry entry;
2832 entry.category = NameCategory::Let;
2833 entry.path = let.path;
2834 entry.derivedFrom = let.value;
2835 add(scope, let.name, std::move(entry));
2836 }
2837 for (QueryDecl const& query : decl.queries) {
2838 NameEntry entry;
2839 entry.category = NameCategory::Query;
2840 entry.path = query.path;
2841 entry.query = &query;
2842 add(scope, query.name, std::move(entry));
2843 _queries.emplace(query.name, &query);
2844 _queryScopes.emplace_back(&query, &scope);
2845 }
2846 for (MutationDecl const& mutation : decl.mutations) {
2847 NameEntry entry;
2848 entry.category = NameCategory::Mutation;
2849 entry.path = mutation.path;
2850 entry.mutation = &mutation;
2851 add(scope, mutation.name, std::move(entry));
2852 _mutations.emplace_back(&mutation, &scope);
2853 collectTransfers(mutation.onSuccess, scope);
2854 collectTransfers(mutation.onError, scope);
2855 }
2856 for (WatchDecl const& watch : decl.watches) {
2857 _watches.emplace_back(&watch, &scope);
2858 collectTransfers(watch.body, scope);
2859 }
2860 }
2861
2862 void collectTransfers(Commands const& commands, ScopeInfo& scope) {
2863 for (Command const& cmd : commands) {
2864 if (cmd.kind == CommandKind::Upload && !cmd.transfer.empty()) {
2865 NameEntry entry;
2866 entry.category = NameCategory::Transfer;
2867 entry.path = pointerAppend(cmd.path, "id");
2868 add(scope, cmd.transfer, std::move(entry));
2869 }
2870 collectTransfers(cmd.commands, scope);
2871 collectTransfers(cmd.alternative, scope);
2872 }
2873 }
2874
2875 void collect(DocNode const& node, ScopeInfo& scope) { collectIn(node, scope); }
2876
2877 void collectIn(DocNode const& node, ScopeInfo& scope) {
2878 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(node.kind, false);
2879 if (!node.id.empty()) {
2880 NameEntry entry;
2881 entry.category = NameCategory::Element;
2882 entry.path = pointerAppend(node.path, "id");
2883 entry.element = &node;
2884 add(scope, node.id, std::move(entry));
2885 _elements.emplace(node.id, &node);
2886 }
2887 ScopeInfo* inner = &scope;
2888 if (spec != nullptr && (spec->flags & kScope) != 0) {
2889 inner = &newScope(&scope, (spec->flags & kRowScope) != 0);
2890 _scopeOf.emplace(&node, inner);
2891 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-unchecked-optional-access): the parser gives every scope-creating node a scope.
2892 declare(*node.scope, *inner);
2893 }
2894 _innerOf.emplace(&node, inner);
2895 for (auto const& [key, commands] : node.events) {
2896 collectTransfers(commands, isInner(spec, key) ? *inner : scope);
2897 }
2898 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : node.keys) {
2899 static_cast<void>(chord);
2900 collectTransfers(commands, scope);
2901 }
2902 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
2903 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
2904 collectIn(*child, isInner(spec, key) ? *inner : scope);
2905 }
2906 }
2907 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
2908 for (DocNodePtr const& child : parts) {
2909 collectPart(*child, isInner(spec, key) ? *inner : scope, *inner, node);
2910 }
2911 }
2912 }
2913
2914 void collectPart(DocNode const& part, ScopeInfo& outer, ScopeInfo& ownerInner, DocNode const& owner) {
2915 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(part.kind, true);
2916 ScopeInfo* inner = &ownerInner;
2917 if (spec != nullptr && (spec->flags & kScope) != 0) {
2918 inner = &newScope(&outer, false);
2919 inner->switchNode = owner.kind == "switch" ? &owner : nullptr;
2920 _scopeOf.emplace(&part, inner);
2921 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-unchecked-optional-access): the parser gives every switch case a scope.
2922 declare(*part.scope, *inner);
2923 } else if (spec != nullptr && (spec->flags & kRowScope) != 0) {
2924 inner = &newScope(&outer, true);
2925 }
2926 _innerOf.emplace(&part, inner);
2927 for (auto const& [key, commands] : part.events) {
2928 collectTransfers(commands, outer);
2929 }
2930 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : part.children) {
2931 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
2932 collectIn(*child, isInner(spec, key) ? *inner : outer);
2933 }
2934 }
2935 for (auto const& [key, parts] : part.parts) {
2936 static_cast<void>(key);
2937 for (DocNodePtr const& child : parts) {
2938 collectPart(*child, outer, ownerInner, part);
2939 }
2940 }
2941 }
2942
2943 [[nodiscard]] static bool isInner(KindSpec const* spec, std::string_view key) {
2944 if (spec == nullptr) {
2945 return false;
2946 }
2947 auto const found = std::ranges::find(spec->keys, key, &KeySpec::key);
2948 return found != spec->keys.end() && (found->flags & kInner) != 0;
2949 }
2950
2951 /// The flags of a child-node key. The parser fills `children` only from a kind's own keys, so the kind and the key
2952 /// are always found.
2953 [[nodiscard]] static std::uint8_t keyFlags(KindSpec const& spec, std::string_view key) {
2954 return std::ranges::find(spec.keys, key, &KeySpec::key)->flags;
2955 }
2956
2957 [[nodiscard]] static bool isCondition(KindSpec const* spec, std::string_view key) {
2958 auto shapeOf = [key](std::span<KeySpec const> keys) {
2959 auto const found = std::ranges::find(keys, key, &KeySpec::key);
2960 return found == keys.end() ? Shape::Expr : found->shape;
2961 };
2962 return (spec != nullptr && shapeOf(spec->keys) == Shape::Condition) ||
2963 shapeOf(kCommonKeys) == Shape::Condition || shapeOf(kFieldKeys) == Shape::Condition;
2964 }
2965
2966 Type checkExpr(Expr const& expr, CheckContext const& context) {
2967 ScopeResolver const resolver{*this, context};
2968 auto checked = checkExpression(expr, resolver);
2969 if (!checked) {
2970 throw DocumentRefused{std::move(checked.error())};
2971 }
2972 return std::move(*checked);
2973 }
2974
2975 void checkCondition(Expr const& expr, CheckContext const& context, std::string_view what) {
2976 Type const type = checkExpr(expr, context);
2977 if (!compatible(Type::of(TypeKind::Bool), type)) {
2978 refuse(expr.path, std::string{what} + " is " + type.name() + "; expected bool");
2979 }
2980 }
2981
2982 // A date input shows a timestamp or an ISO-8601 date or date-time string; any other type it can never show.
2983 void checkDateValue(DocNode const& node, Expr const& expr, Type const& type) {
2984 if (type.kind == TypeKind::String || type.kind == TypeKind::Timestamp) {
2985 _dateValueKinds.insert_or_assign(&node, type.kind);
2986 } else if (type.kind != TypeKind::Any && type.kind != TypeKind::Key) {
2987 refuse(expr.path,
2988 "`dateTimeInput` shows a timestamp or an ISO-8601 date or date-time string; `value` is " +
2989 type.name());
2990 }
2991 }
2992
2993 [[nodiscard]] static NameEntry& require(CheckContext const& context, std::string const& name,
2994 std::string const& path, std::initializer_list<NameCategory> categories,
2995 std::string_view what) {
2996 NameEntry* const entry = lookup(context.scope, name);
2997 if (entry == nullptr || std::ranges::find(categories, entry->category) == categories.end()) {
2998 refuse(path, "`" + name + "` is not " + std::string{what} + " of this scope");
2999 }
3000 return *entry;
3001 }
3002
3003 // How many row scopes enclose @p scope, itself included, up to its screen or component fallback.
3004 [[nodiscard]] static std::size_t rowDepth(ScopeInfo const* scope) {
3005 std::size_t rows = 0;
3006 for (; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent) {
3007 rows += scope->row ? 1U : 0U;
3008 }
3009 return rows;
3010 }
3011
3012 // The element @p name declares in @p scope itself, or nothing.
3013 [[nodiscard]] static NameEntry const* elementIn(ScopeInfo const& scope, std::string_view name) {
3014 auto const found = scope.names.find(name);
3015 return found != scope.names.end() && found->second.category == NameCategory::Element ? &found->second
3016 : nullptr;
3017 }
3018
3019 // The elements named @p name in the switch cases below @p scope, at any depth through cases only.
3020 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): the scope tree, walked down through switch cases.
3021 static void elementsInCases(ScopeInfo const& scope, std::string_view name, std::vector<NameEntry const*>& out) {
3022 for (ScopeInfo const* const child : scope.children) {
3023 if (child->switchNode == nullptr) {
3024 continue;
3025 }
3026 if (NameEntry const* const entry = elementIn(*child, name)) {
3027 out.push_back(entry);
3028 }
3029 elementsInCases(*child, name, out);
3030 }
3031 }
3032
3033 // The row scopes directly below @p scope, or below it through switch cases, that declare the element @p name.
3034 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): the scope tree, walked down through switch cases.
3035 static void rowScopesBelow(ScopeInfo const& scope, std::string_view name, std::vector<ScopeInfo const*>& out) {
3036 for (ScopeInfo const* const child : scope.children) {
3037 if (child->row) {
3038 if (elementIn(*child, name) != nullptr && std::ranges::find(out, child) == out.end()) {
3039 out.push_back(child);
3040 }
3041 } else if (child->switchNode != nullptr) {
3042 rowScopesBelow(*child, name, out);
3043 }
3044 }
3045 }
3046
3047 // A `focus` target resolves to declarations. Without `row`: the element the scope chain names, else those in the
3048 // switch cases below the chain, which must all be cases of one switch (at most one case is mounted). With `row`:
3049 // the one row scope that declares it among the chain's and those below the chain through switch cases.
3050 void checkFocus(Command const& cmd, CheckContext const& context) {
3051 FocusTarget target{.candidates = {}, .row = cmd.extra != nullptr};
3052 if (cmd.extra) {
3053 checkExpr(*cmd.extra, context);
3054 std::vector<ScopeInfo const*> found;
3055 for (ScopeInfo const* scope = context.scope; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent) {
3056 if (scope->row && elementIn(*scope, cmd.target) != nullptr &&
3057 std::ranges::find(found, scope) == found.end()) {
3058 found.push_back(scope);
3059 }
3060 rowScopesBelow(*scope, cmd.target, found);
3061 }
3062 if (found.empty()) {
3063 refuse(pointerAppend(cmd.path, "row"), "`row` names a row of a `forEach` or table; `" + cmd.target +
3064 "` is not an element of a row scope this command reaches");
3065 }
3066 if (found.size() > 1) {
3067 refuse(cmd.path, "`" + cmd.target + "` is declared in two row scopes this command reaches, at " +
3068 elementIn(*found.at(0), cmd.target)->path + " and " +
3069 elementIn(*found.at(1), cmd.target)->path);
3070 }
3071 target.candidates.push_back(FocusCandidate{.path = elementIn(*found.front(), cmd.target)->element->path,
3072 .rows = rowDepth(found.front())});
3073 } else if (lookup(context.scope, cmd.target) != nullptr) {
3074 NameEntry const& entry = require(context, cmd.target, cmd.path, {NameCategory::Element}, "an element");
3075 target.candidates.push_back(FocusCandidate{.path = entry.element->path, .rows = rowDepth(entry.scope)});
3076 } else {
3077 std::vector<NameEntry const*> inCases;
3078 for (ScopeInfo const* scope = context.scope; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent) {
3079 elementsInCases(*scope, cmd.target, inCases);
3080 }
3081 if (inCases.empty()) {
3082 static_cast<void>(require(context, cmd.target, cmd.path, {NameCategory::Element}, "an element"));
3083 }
3084 for (NameEntry const* const entry : inCases) {
3085 if (entry->scope->switchNode != inCases.front()->scope->switchNode) {
3086 refuse(cmd.path, "`" + cmd.target + "` is declared in the cases of two switches, at " +
3087 inCases.front()->path + " and " + entry->path +
3088 "; both may be mounted, so a focus cannot choose");
3089 }
3090 target.candidates.push_back(
3091 FocusCandidate{.path = entry->element->path, .rows = rowDepth(entry->scope)});
3092 }
3093 }
3094 _focusTargets.insert_or_assign(cmd.path, std::move(target));
3095 }
3096
3097 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): the alias, then the action it runs, as a query reads.
3098 std::optional<ActionInfo> checkModelAction(CheckContext const& context, std::string const& alias,
3099 std::string const& action, std::string const& path) {
3100 std::string const modelPath = pointerAppend(path, "model");
3101 NameEntry const& model = require(context, alias, modelPath, {NameCategory::Model}, "a model alias");
3102 if (!_options->catalog.action) {
3103 return std::nullopt;
3104 }
3105 auto const info = _options->catalog.action(action);
3106 if (!info) {
3107 refuse(path, "the action `" + action + "` is not in the catalog");
3108 }
3109 if (info->modelType != model.model->type) {
3110 refuse(path, "the action `" + action + "` belongs to `" + info->modelType + "`, not `" +
3111 model.model->type + "`");
3112 }
3113 return info;
3114 }
3115
3116 void checkScope(ScopeDecl const& decl, CheckContext const& context) {
3117 for (ModelDecl const& model : decl.models) {
3118 if (model.key) {
3119 checkExpr(*model.key, context);
3120 }
3121 }
3122 for (StateDecl const& state : decl.state) {
3123 if (!state.init) {
3124 continue;
3125 }
3126 Type const type = checkExpr(*state.init, context);
3127 bool const literalFits = state.init->kind != ExprKind::Literal || state.type.admits(state.init->literal);
3128 if (!literalFits || !compatible(state.type, type)) {
3129 refuse(state.init->path,
3130 "the init of `" + state.name + "` does not have its type " + state.type.name());
3131 }
3132 // The type is derived now, so a state no expression reads is still checked.
3133 auto const derived = derivedType(*lookup(context.scope, state.name), state.name);
3134 static_cast<void>(derived);
3135 }
3136 for (LetDecl const& let : decl.lets) {
3137 auto type = derivedType(*lookup(context.scope, let.name), let.name);
3138 static_cast<void>(type);
3139 }
3140 for (QueryDecl const& query : decl.queries) {
3141 checkQuery(query, context);
3142 }
3143 for (MutationDecl const& mutation : decl.mutations) {
3144 checkMutation(mutation, context);
3145 }
3146 for (WatchDecl const& watch : decl.watches) {
3147 checkExpr(*watch.on, context);
3148 checkCommands(watch.body, context);
3149 }
3150 for (CheckDecl const& check : decl.checks) {
3151 checkCondition(*check.assertion, context, "the `assert` of a check");
3152 if (check.message) {
3153 checkExpr(*check.message, context);
3154 }
3155 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < check.targets.size(); ++index) {
3156 static_cast<void>(require(context, check.targets.at(index),
3157 pointerAppend(pointerAppend(check.path, "targets"), index),
3158 {NameCategory::Element}, "an element"));
3159 }
3160 }
3161 }
3162
3163 void checkQuery(QueryDecl const& query, CheckContext const& context) {
3164 auto const action = checkModelAction(context, query.model, query.action, query.path);
3165 // An evaluation runs no handler, so only a call can change anything.
3166 if (action && action->effects && !query.evaluate) {
3167 refuse(query.path, std::format("a query reads, so its action declares no effects; `{}` declares {}, "
3168 "so it runs as a mutation",
3169 query.action, describeEffects(*action->effects)));
3170 }
3171 if (query.body) {
3172 checkExpr(*query.body, context);
3173 }
3174 if (query.when) {
3175 checkCondition(*query.when, context, "`when`");
3176 }
3177 }
3178
3179 void checkMutation(MutationDecl const& mutation, CheckContext const& context) {
3180 auto const action = checkModelAction(context, mutation.model, mutation.action, mutation.path);
3181 if (mutation.body) {
3182 checkExpr(*mutation.body, context);
3183 }
3184 if (mutation.serialKey) {
3185 CheckContext keyContext = context;
3186 keyContext.bindings.emplace_back("body", Type::any());
3187 checkExpr(*mutation.serialKey, keyContext);
3188 }
3189 if (mutation.optimistic) {
3190 OptimisticDecl const& decl = *mutation.optimistic;
3191 std::string const path = pointerAppend(mutation.path, "optimistic");
3192 auto const target = _queries.find(decl.query);
3193 if (target == _queries.end()) {
3194 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "query"), "`" + decl.query + "` is not a query of this document");
3195 }
3196 CheckContext bodyContext = context;
3197 bodyContext.bindings.emplace_back("body", Type::any());
3198 checkExpr(*decl.key, bodyContext);
3199 checkExpr(*decl.with, bodyContext);
3200 checkPatchAt(decl.query, decl.at, *target->second, path);
3201 checkOptimistic(decl, *target->second);
3202 }
3203 if (mutation.offlineQueue && action) {
3204 if (action->credential || !action->secretFields.empty()) {
3205 refuse(pointerAppend(mutation.path, "offline"),
3206 "a mutation that sends a credential or returns a secret is never queued offline");
3207 }
3208 }
3209 checkCommands(mutation.onSuccess, context);
3210 checkCommands(mutation.onError, context);
3211 }
3212
3213 // Only a catalog that knows the result is a record can say a patch misses its list; otherwise the interpreter
3214 // reports the miss when the patch runs.
3215 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): the query's name, then the member holding the list.
3216 void checkPatchAt(std::string const& queryName, std::string const& listMember, QueryDecl const& query,
3217 std::string const& path) {
3218 if (!_options->catalog.action) {
3219 return;
3220 }
3221 auto const info = _options->catalog.action(query.action);
3222 if (!info || !info->listFields) {
3223 return;
3224 }
3225 if (listMember.empty()) {
3226 refuse(path, std::format("`{}` answers a record, so a patch of `{}` names the member holding its list "
3227 "with `at`",
3228 query.action, queryName));
3229 }
3230 if (std::ranges::find(*info->listFields, listMember) == info->listFields->end()) {
3231 refuse(pointerAppend(path, "at"),
3232 std::format("the result of `{}` has no list member `{}`", query.action, listMember));
3233 }
3234 }
3235
3236 void checkOptimistic(OptimisticDecl const& decl, QueryDecl const& query) {
3237 if (!_options->catalog.action || decl.with->kind != ExprKind::Object) {
3238 return;
3239 }
3240 auto const info = _options->catalog.action(query.action);
3241 if (!info) {
3242 return;
3243 }
3244 for (auto const& [field, value] : decl.with->fields) {
3245 if (std::ranges::find(info->calculatedFields, field) != info->calculatedFields.end()) {
3246 refuse(value->path,
3247 std::format("`{}` is calculated by the server and is never written optimistically", field));
3248 }
3249 }
3250 }
3251
3252 void checkPrefetch() {
3253 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < _doc->prefetch.size(); ++index) {
3254 std::string const& name = _doc->prefetch.at(index);
3255 std::string const path = pointerAppend("/prefetch", index);
3256 auto const found = std::ranges::find(_doc->scope.queries, name, &QueryDecl::name);
3257 if (found == _doc->scope.queries.end()) {
3258 refuse(path, "`" + name + "` is not a query of the screen");
3259 }
3260 if (found->body && !readsOnlyParams(*found->body)) {
3261 refuse(path, "the body of `" + name + "` reads more than the screen's params, so it cannot prefetch");
3262 }
3263 }
3264 }
3265
3266 [[nodiscard]] bool readsOnlyParams(Expr const& expr) const {
3267 if (expr.kind == ExprKind::Ref) {
3268 return std::ranges::find(_doc->params, expr.name, &std::pair<std::string, Type>::first) !=
3269 _doc->params.end();
3270 }
3271 if (expr.kind != ExprKind::Literal && expr.kind != ExprKind::Call && expr.kind != ExprKind::If &&
3272 expr.kind != ExprKind::Object && expr.kind != ExprKind::List && expr.kind != ExprKind::Get) {
3273 return false;
3274 }
3275 bool only = true;
3276 for (ExprPtr const& arg : expr.args) {
3277 only = only && readsOnlyParams(*arg);
3278 }
3279 for (auto const& [name, field] : expr.fields) {
3280 static_cast<void>(name);
3281 only = only && readsOnlyParams(*field);
3282 }
3283 return only;
3284 }
3285
3286 void checkCustomizePoints() {
3287 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> arranged;
3288 for (auto const& [name, point] : _doc->customize) {
3289 static_cast<void>(name);
3290 if (point.kind == "columns" && _doc->view) {
3291 auto const found = _elements.find(point.of);
3292 if (found == _elements.end() || found->second->kind != "table") {
3293 refuse(pointerAppend(point.path, "of"),
3294 "a `columns` point names a table; `" + point.of + "` is not one");
3295 }
3296 }
3297 if (point.kind == "arrange") {
3298 checkArranged(point, arranged);
3299 }
3300 }
3301 }
3302
3303 // The stored order names children by id, so the container is a stack whose every child has one, and one point
3304 // orders it: two would each claim the order.
3305 void checkArranged(CustomizePoint const& point, std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& arranged) {
3306 auto const found = _elements.find(point.of);
3307 if (found == _elements.end() || (found->second->kind != "column" && found->second->kind != "row") ||
3308 found->second->nodes("children").empty()) {
3309 refuse(pointerAppend(point.path, "of"),
3310 "an `arrange` point names a column or row of this screen that has children; `" + point.of +
3311 "` is not one");
3312 }
3313 for (DocNodePtr const& child : found->second->nodes("children")) {
3314 if (child->id.empty()) {
3315 refuse(pointerAppend(point.path, "of"),
3316 "an `arrange` point orders its container's children by id; a child of `" + point.of +
3317 "` has none");
3318 }
3319 }
3320 // An arranged container is drawn as a keyed list, which places its children as a list does.
3321 std::string const asList =
3322 "an arranged `" + found->second->kind + "` is drawn as a list, which takes no `align` or `justify`";
3323 for (std::string_view const key : {"align", "justify"}) {
3324 if (!found->second->name(key).empty()) {
3325 refuse(pointerAppend(found->second->path, key), asList);
3326 }
3327 }
3328 if (!arranged.insert(point.of).second) {
3329 refuse(pointerAppend(point.path, "of"), "`" + point.of + "` is arranged by another point");
3330 }
3331 }
3332
3333 [[nodiscard]] CheckContext innerContext(DocNode const& node, CheckContext const& context) const {
3334 CheckContext inner = context;
3335 inner.scope = _innerOf.at(&node);
3336 return inner;
3337 }
3338
3339 void checkNode(DocNode const& node, CheckContext const& context) {
3340 if (!node.name("alignSelf").empty()) {
3341 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "alignSelf"), std::string{kAlignSelfPlaces});
3342 }
3343 if (node.flag("bleed")) {
3344 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "bleed"), std::string{kBleedPlaces});
3345 }
3346 checkElement(node, context, false);
3347 }
3348
3349 // What `alignSelf` places a node in.
3350 static constexpr std::string_view kAlignSelfPlaces = "`alignSelf` places a node in its row, column or grid";
3351
3352 // What `bleed` reaches past: the horizontal padding of the stack, panel or tab page that holds the node.
3353 static constexpr std::string_view kBleedPlaces = "`bleed` is a child's of a column, a panel or a tab";
3354
3355 // Whether the nodes under @p key of @p parent may be sized by a share of its width: a row that does not wrap, a
3356 // splitter that is not literally vertical, and a `forEach` that is literally horizontal and does not wrap (its
3357 // rows are the children of a row).
3358 static bool takesPercent(DocNode const& parent, std::string_view key) {
3359 // The content of a switch case or of an overlay is mounted into a holder that fills its slot: the interpreter
3360 // reports a share there and makes the node fill, so the loader leaves it to the interpreter.
3361 if (parent.kind == "case" || parent.kind == "switch" || parent.kind == "dialog" || parent.kind == "drawer") {
3362 return true;
3363 }
3364 if (key != "children") {
3365 return false;
3366 }
3367 if (parent.kind == "row") {
3368 return !parent.flag("wrap");
3369 }
3370 if (parent.kind == "splitter") {
3371 ExprPtr const orientation = parent.prop("orientation");
3372 if (orientation != nullptr && orientation->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
3373 std::string const* const named = orientation->literal.asString();
3374 return named == nullptr || *named != "vertical";
3375 }
3376 return true;
3377 }
3378 if (parent.kind == "forEach") {
3379 ExprPtr const axis = parent.prop("axis");
3380 if (axis == nullptr || axis->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
3381 return false;
3382 }
3383 std::string const* const named = axis->literal.asString();
3384 return named != nullptr && *named == "horizontal" && !parent.flag("wrap");
3385 }
3386 return false;
3387 }
3388
3389 // A child that places itself sits in a row, a column, a grid or a `forEach`; any other parent (a panel, a dialog,
3390 // a tab page) has no cross axis to place it on.
3391 static void checkPlacements(DocNode const& parent) {
3392 bool const places = parent.kind == "row" || parent.kind == "column" || parent.kind == "grid" ||
3393 parent.kind == "forEach" || parent.kind == "actionBar";
3394 bool const bleeds = parent.kind == "column" || parent.kind == "panel" || parent.kind == "tab";
3395 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : parent.children) {
3396 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
3397 if (!child->name("alignSelf").empty() && (!places || key != "children")) {
3398 refuse(pointerAppend(child->path, "alignSelf"), std::string{kAlignSelfPlaces});
3399 }
3400 if (child->flag("bleed") && (!bleeds || key != "children")) {
3401 refuse(pointerAppend(child->path, "bleed"), std::string{kBleedPlaces});
3402 }
3403 if (hasPercentWidth(*child) && !takesPercent(parent, key)) {
3404 refuse(pointerAppend(child->path, "sizing"), std::string{kPercentPlaces});
3405 }
3406 }
3407 }
3408 }
3409
3410 // A tab page's padding is `pageInset`, else `inset`, both literal steps. A page of no padding has nothing for a
3411 // child's `bleed` to reach past, so the document is refused rather than the flag silently doing nothing; a step
3412 // that is computed is left to the mount. Any node that is not a `tabs` is passed over.
3413 static void checkTabBleed(DocNode const& tabs) {
3414 if (tabs.kind != "tabs") {
3415 return;
3416 }
3417 auto const step = [&tabs](std::string_view key) -> std::optional<std::int64_t> {
3418 ExprPtr const expr = tabs.prop(key);
3419 if (expr == nullptr) {
3420 return std::nullopt;
3421 }
3422 std::int64_t const* const literal = expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? expr->literal.asInt() : nullptr;
3423 return literal != nullptr ? std::optional<std::int64_t>{*literal} : std::optional<std::int64_t>{-1};
3424 };
3425 auto const page = step("pageInset");
3426 auto const outer = step("inset");
3427 std::int64_t const effective = page.value_or(outer.value_or(0));
3428 if (effective != 0) {
3429 return;
3430 }
3431 for (DocNodePtr const& tab : tabs.partList("tabs")) {
3432 auto const found = tab->children.find("children");
3433 if (found == tab->children.end()) {
3434 continue;
3435 }
3436 for (DocNodePtr const& child : found->second) {
3437 if (child->flag("bleed")) {
3438 refuse(pointerAppend(child->path, "bleed"),
3439 "`bleed` reaches past the padding of the tab page, and this page has none: give the tabs "
3440 "a `pageInset`, or an `inset`, above 0");
3441 }
3442 }
3443 }
3444 }
3445
3446 void checkElement(DocNode const& node, CheckContext const& outer, bool part) {
3447 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(node.kind, part);
3448 CheckContext const inner = innerContext(node, outer);
3449 if (auto const found = _scopeOf.find(&node); found != _scopeOf.end()) {
3450 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-unchecked-optional-access): a node or case with a scope of its own has its declarations.
3451 checkScope(*node.scope, inner);
3452 }
3453 checkProps(node, spec, inner, outer);
3454 for (auto const& [key, commands] : node.events) {
3455 if (node.kind == "custom") {
3456 checkCustomEvent(node, key.substr(3), node.path);
3457 }
3458 checkCommands(commands, isInner(spec, key) ? inner : outer);
3459 }
3460 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : node.keys) {
3461 static_cast<void>(chord);
3462 checkCommands(commands, outer);
3463 }
3464 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
3465 CheckContext context = isInner(spec, key) ? inner : outer;
3466 context.boundaryError = (keyFlags(*spec, key) & kBoundaryError) != 0 || context.boundaryError;
3467 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
3468 checkElement(*child, context, false);
3469 }
3470 }
3471 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
3472 CheckContext const& context = isInner(spec, key) ? inner : outer;
3473 for (DocNodePtr const& child : parts) {
3474 checkElement(*child, context, true);
3475 }
3476 }
3477 checkPlacements(node);
3478 checkTabBleed(node);
3479 if (part) {
3480 checkPartNode(node);
3481 } else {
3482 checkFlags(node);
3483 checkLayoutKeys(node);
3484 checkKindRules(node, outer);
3485 // An overlay's footer actions; a form's field components.
3486 checkActionButtons(node.partList("actions"), pointerAppend(node.path, "actions"));
3487 checkFieldComponents(node);
3488 }
3489 }
3490
3491 static void checkPartNode(DocNode const& node) {
3492 if (node.kind == "column" || node.kind == "track") {
3493 checkNoPercentWidth(node);
3494 }
3495 if (node.kind == "column") {
3496 checkColumnPart(node);
3497 } else if (node.kind == "track") {
3498 checkCellPlace(node, "align");
3499 } else if (isMenuEntry(node.kind)) {
3500 checkMenuItem(node);
3501 }
3502 }
3503
3504 void checkProps(DocNode const& node, KindSpec const* spec, CheckContext const& inner, CheckContext const& outer) {
3505 for (auto const& [key, expr] : node.props) {
3506 CheckContext const& context = isInner(spec, key) ? inner : outer;
3507 if (isCondition(spec, key)) {
3508 checkCondition(*expr, context, "`" + key + "`");
3509 continue;
3510 }
3511 Type const type = checkExpr(*expr, context);
3512 if (node.kind == "dateTimeInput" && key == "value") {
3513 checkDateValue(node, *expr, type);
3514 }
3515 }
3516 }
3517
3518 void checkCustomEvent(DocNode const& node, std::string const& event, std::string const& path) {
3519 auto const found = _doc->components.find(node.name("name"));
3520 if (found != _doc->components.end() && !found->second.events.contains(event)) {
3521 refuse(pointerAppend(pointerAppend(path, "on"), event),
3522 "the component `" + found->second.name + "` declares no event `" + event + "`");
3523 }
3524 }

3526 // What a chart's literal keys may be, and the shape of its series and lines. A computed `tone` or `yMin` is
3527 // checked when it is evaluated, and reported then.
3528 static void checkChart(DocNode const& node) {
3529 static constexpr std::size_t kMaxSeries = 4;
3530 static constexpr std::size_t kMaxLines = 16;
3531 std::span<DocNodePtr const> const series = node.partList("series");
3532 std::string const seriesPath = pointerAppend(node.path, "series");
3533 if (series.empty() || series.size() > kMaxSeries) {
3534 refuse(seriesPath, "a chart draws 1 to 4 series");
3535 }
3536 if (node.partList("lines").size() > kMaxLines) {
3537 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "lines"), "a chart draws at most 16 reference lines");
3538 }
3539 bool const positioned = series.front()->prop("x") != nullptr;
3540 for (DocNodePtr const& part : series) {
3541 DocNode const& one = *part;
3542 if (series.size() > 1 && one.prop("label") == nullptr) {
3543 refuse(one.path, "each of two or more series has a `label`, its name in the legend");
3544 }
3545 if ((one.prop("x") != nullptr) != positioned) {
3546 refuse(one.path, "`x` is on every series of a chart or on none");
3547 }
3548 checkChartTone(one);
3549 }
3550 for (DocNodePtr const& line : node.partList("lines")) {
3551 checkChartTone(*line);
3552 std::string_view const style = line->name("style");
3553 if (!style.empty() && style != "solid" && style != "dashed" && style != "dotted") {
3554 refuse(pointerAppend(line->path, "style"), "`style` is `solid`, `dashed` or `dotted`");
3555 }
3556 }
3557 if (ExprPtr const places = node.prop("yPlaces")) {
3558 std::int64_t const* const literal = places->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? places->literal.asInt() : nullptr;
3559 if (literal == nullptr || *literal < 0 || std::cmp_greater(*literal, math::kMaxDecimalPlaces)) {
3560 refuse(places->path, "`yPlaces` is a literal integer from 0 to 18");
3561 }
3562 }
3563 ExprPtr const low = node.prop("yMin");
3564 ExprPtr const high = node.prop("yMax");
3565 if (low && high && low->kind == ExprKind::Literal && high->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
3566 std::optional<Number> const lowNumber = numeric(low->literal);
3567 std::optional<Number> const highNumber = numeric(high->literal);
3568 if (lowNumber && highNumber && highNumber->value < lowNumber->value) {
3569 refuse(low->path, "`yMin` is above `yMax`");
3570 }
3571 }
3572 }
3573
3574 // A literal `tone` of a chart's series or line names one of the five tones; `null` marks nothing.
3575 static void checkChartTone(DocNode const& part) {
3576 ExprPtr const tone = part.prop("tone");
3577 if (!tone || tone->kind != ExprKind::Literal || tone->literal.isNull()) {
3578 return;
3579 }
3580 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 5> kTones = {"neutral", "info", "ok", "warn", "err"};
3581 std::string const* const name = tone->literal.asString();
3582 if (name == nullptr || !listed(kTones, *name)) {
3583 refuse(tone->path, "`tone` is `neutral`, `info`, `ok`, `warn` or `err`");
3584 }
3585 }
3586
3587 // A flag that needs a key beside it.
3588 static void checkFlags(DocNode const& node) {
3589 if (node.flag("showLabel") && node.prop("label") == nullptr) {
3590 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "showLabel"), "`showLabel` shows the `label`, and the node gives none");
3591 }
3592 }
3593
3594 void checkKindRules(DocNode const& node, CheckContext const& context) {
3595 if (node.kind == "custom") {
3596 checkCustomProps(node);
3597 } else if (node.kind == "tabs") {
3598 checkTabIds(node);
3599 checkTabsInset(node);
3600 } else if (node.kind == "chart") {
3601 checkChart(node);
3602 } else if (node.kind == "customize" && !_doc->customize.contains(node.name("point"))) {
3603 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "point"),
3604 "`" + std::string{node.name("point")} + "` is not a customization point of this document");
3605 }
3606 checkKindValues(node);
3607 checkSheet(node);
3608 std::string_view const model = node.name("model");
3609 if (!model.empty()) {
3610 if (node.name("action").empty()) {
3611 refuse(node.path, "a `" + node.kind + "` with a `model` names its `action`");
3612 }
3613 checkModelAction(context, std::string{model}, std::string{node.name("action")}, node.path);
3614 } else if (node.kind == "table" && !node.prop("rows")) {
3615 refuse(node.path, "a table takes `rows`, or a `model` and `action`");
3616 }
3617 if (node.kind == "table") {
3618 checkTableSelection(node);
3619 checkSelectColumn(node);
3620 checkTableSort(node);
3621 checkTablePaging(node);
3622 checkTableGroup(node);
3623 checkRowsTableKeys(node);
3624 }
3625 }
3626
3627 // A dialog's `sheet` and the label of its dismiss control: a drawer already fills the height on a phone and takes
3628 // neither, and a `dismissLabel` labels only a sheet's control.
3629 static void checkSheet(DocNode const& node) {
3630 if (node.kind == "drawer") {
3631 for (std::string_view const key : {"sheet", "dismissLabel"}) {
3632 if (node.prop(key)) {
3633 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, key),
3634 "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a dialog's; a drawer already fills the height");
3635 }
3636 }
3637 } else if (node.kind == "dialog" && node.prop("dismissLabel") && !node.prop("sheet")) {
3638 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "dismissLabel"),
3639 "`dismissLabel` labels a sheet's dismiss control; give the dialog `sheet`");
3640 }
3641 }
3642
3643 // A sortable column is named by its id, which a sort key gives; `sortBy` says how a sortable column orders. A
3644 // literal `sort` names sortable columns, each once, with a direction, and `onSortChange` needs a header that
3645 // sorts. A model-backed table's engine sorts, so none of these belongs on one.
3646 static void checkTableSort(DocNode const& node) {
3647 bool const modelBacked = !node.name("model").empty();
3648 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> sortable;
3649 for (DocNodePtr const& column : node.partList("columns")) {
3650 bool const sorts = column->flag("sortable");
3651 if (sorts && modelBacked) {
3652 refuse(pointerAppend(column->path, "sortable"),
3653 "a model-backed table's engine sorts; `sortable` is for a table over `rows`");
3654 }
3655 if (sorts && column->id.empty()) {
3656 refuse(pointerAppend(column->path, "sortable"), "a sortable column needs an `id`, which a sort names");
3657 }
3658 if (column->prop("sortBy") != nullptr && !sorts) {
3659 refuse(pointerAppend(column->path, "sortBy"),
3660 "`sortBy` says how a sortable column orders the rows; give the column `sortable`");
3661 }
3662 if (sorts) {
3663 sortable.insert(column->id);
3664 }
3665 }
3666 if (node.event("onSortChange") != nullptr && sortable.empty()) {
3667 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "onSortChange"),
3668 "`onSortChange` runs when a header sorts the table; give a column `sortable`");
3669 }
3670 ExprPtr const sort = node.prop("sort");
3671 if (sort != nullptr && sort->kind == ExprKind::Literal && !modelBacked && !sort->literal.isNull()) {
3672 checkLiteralSort(sort->literal, pointerAppend(node.path, "sort"), sortable);
3673 }
3674 }
3675
3676 // A literal sort: a list of keys, each naming one of @p sortable once, with a direction.
3677 static void checkLiteralSort(Value const& sort, std::string const& where,
3678 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> const& sortable) {
3679 ValueList const* const keys = sort.asList();
3680 if (keys == nullptr) {
3681 refuse(
3682 where,
3683 R"(a table's sort is a list of keys, each {"column": <a sortable column's id>, "direction": "asc" or "desc"})");
3684 }
3685 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> named;
3686 for (Value const& key : *keys) {
3687 Value const* const column = key.field("column");
3688 Value const* const direction = key.field("direction");
3689 std::string const* const columnId = column == nullptr ? nullptr : column->asString();
3690 std::string const* const way = direction == nullptr ? nullptr : direction->asString();
3691 if (columnId == nullptr || way == nullptr || (*way != "asc" && *way != "desc")) {
3692 refuse(where, R"(a sort key is {"column": <a sortable column's id>, "direction": "asc" or "desc"})");
3693 }
3694 if (!sortable.contains(*columnId)) {
3695 refuse(where, "the sort names `" + *columnId + "`, which is not a sortable column");
3696 }
3697 if (!named.insert(*columnId).second) {
3698 refuse(where, "the sort names `" + *columnId + "` twice");
3699 }
3700 }
3701 }
3702
3703 // A table over `rows` draws its own group headings; a model-backed table's engine shapes its rows.
3704 static void checkTableGroup(DocNode const& node) {
3705 if (!node.name("model").empty() && !node.partList("group").empty()) {
3706 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "group"),
3707 "a model-backed table's engine shapes its rows; `group` is for a table over `rows`");
3708 }
3709 }
3710
3711 // A table over `rows` pages itself by `pageSize`, at `page`; a model-backed table's engine pages.
3712 static void checkTablePaging(DocNode const& node) {
3713 ExprPtr const size = node.prop("pageSize");
3714 ExprPtr const page = node.prop("page");
3715 if (!node.name("model").empty() && (size != nullptr || page != nullptr)) {
3716 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, size != nullptr ? "pageSize" : "page"),
3717 "a model-backed table's engine pages; `pageSize` and `page` are for a table over `rows`");
3718 }
3719 if (page != nullptr && size == nullptr) {
3720 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "page"),
3721 "`page` picks a page of `pageSize` rows; give the table `pageSize`");
3722 }
3723 if (size != nullptr && size->kind == ExprKind::Literal && !size->literal.isNull()) {
3724 std::int64_t const* const rows = size->literal.asInt();
3725 if (rows == nullptr || *rows < 1) {
3726 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "pageSize"), "a page holds a positive whole number of rows");
3727 }
3728 }
3729 }
3730
3731 // The keys of a model-backed table that a table over `rows` would accept and ignore.
3732 static void checkRowsTableKeys(DocNode const& node) {
3733 if (!node.prop("rows")) {
3734 return;
3735 }
3736 if (node.prop("filters") != nullptr) {
3737 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "filters"),
3738 "`filters` belongs to a model-backed table; filter `rows` with `filter`");
3739 }
3740 if (node.prop("highlightKey") != nullptr) {
3741 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "highlightKey"), "`highlightKey` links a model-backed table to a chart");
3742 }
3743 }
3744
3745 // The select column draws a `multiple` table's selection, so it needs a literal `multiple`; its header's name
3746 // needs the column.
3747 static void checkSelectColumn(DocNode const& node) {
3748 bool const drawn = node.flag("selectColumn");
3749 if (drawn) {
3750 ExprPtr const mode = node.prop("selectionMode");
3751 std::string const* const literal =
3752 mode != nullptr && mode->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? mode->literal.asString() : nullptr;
3753 if (literal == nullptr || *literal != "multiple") {
3754 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "selectColumn"),
3755 "a select column draws a table's selection of several rows; give it `selectionMode` "
3756 "`multiple`");
3757 }
3758 }
3759 if (!drawn && node.prop("selectAllLabel") != nullptr) {
3760 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "selectAllLabel"),
3761 "`selectAllLabel` names the select column's header "
3762 "box; give the table `selectColumn`");
3763 }
3764 }
3765
3766 // A table's `selection` and `onSelectionChange` need rows the user can select, and rows the document holds: a
3767 // model-backed table's engine owns its selection.
3768 static void checkTableSelection(DocNode const& node) {
3769 std::string_view key;
3770 if (node.prop("selection") != nullptr) {
3771 key = "selection";
3772 } else if (node.event("onSelectionChange") != nullptr) {
3773 key = "onSelectionChange";
3774 } else {
3775 return;
3776 }
3777 std::string const where = pointerAppend(node.path, key);
3778 if (!node.name("model").empty()) {
3779 refuse(where, "a model-backed table's engine owns its selection; `" + std::string{key} +
3780 "` is for a table over `rows`");
3781 }
3782 ExprPtr const mode = node.prop("selectionMode");
3783 std::string const* const literal =
3784 mode != nullptr && mode->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? mode->literal.asString() : nullptr;
3785 if (mode == nullptr || (literal != nullptr && *literal == "none")) {
3786 refuse(where, "a table with `" + std::string{key} +
3787 "` selects rows; give it `selectionMode` `single` or `multiple`");
3788 }
3789 }
3790
3791 // A tabs node that names its shown tab, or reports a pick, keys every tab by a unique id; a literal `selected`
3792 // names one of them. A literal `null` is no binding.
3793 static void checkTabIds(DocNode const& node) {
3794 ExprPtr const selected = node.prop("selected");
3795 bool const bound = selected != nullptr && (selected->kind != ExprKind::Literal || !selected->literal.isNull());
3796 bool const keyed = bound || node.event("onChoose") != nullptr;
3797 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> ids;
3798 for (DocNodePtr const& tab : node.partList("tabs")) {
3799 if (tab->id.empty()) {
3800 if (keyed) {
3801 refuse(tab->path, "a tab of a tabs node with `selected` or `onChoose` has an `id`");
3802 }
3803 continue;
3804 }
3805 if (!ids.insert(tab->id).second) {
3806 refuse(pointerAppend(tab->path, "id"),
3807 "the tab id `" + tab->id + "` is used twice; each tab has its own");
3808 }
3809 }
3810 if (bound && selected->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
3811 std::string const* const named = selected->literal.asString();
3812 if (named == nullptr || !ids.contains(*named)) {
3813 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "selected"), "`selected` names no tab of this node");
3814 }
3815 }
3816 }
3817
3818 // A tabs node's `inset` and `pageInset` are literal spacing steps, 0 to 5: the strip and the pages are laid out
3819 // once.
3820 static void checkTabsInset(DocNode const& node) {
3821 for (std::string_view const key : {"inset", "pageInset"}) {
3822 ExprPtr const inset = node.prop(key);
3823 if (inset == nullptr) {
3824 continue;
3825 }
3826 std::int64_t const* const step = inset->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? inset->literal.asInt() : nullptr;
3827 if (step == nullptr || *step < 0 || *step > 5) {
3828 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, key),
3829 "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a literal spacing step from 0 to 5");
3830 }
3831 }
3832 }
3833
3834 // A custom node names a component of the document and gives only the props it declares.
3835 void checkCustomProps(DocNode const& node) const {
3836 auto const found = _doc->components.find(node.name("name"));
3837 if (found == _doc->components.end()) {
3838 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "name"),
3839 "`" + std::string{node.name("name")} + "` is not a component of this document");
3840 }
3841 for (DocNodePtr const& props : node.partList("props")) {
3842 for (auto const& [prop, value] : props->props) {
3843 if (!found->second.props.contains(prop)) {
3844 refuse(value->path, "the component `" + found->first + "` declares no prop `" + prop + "`");
3845 }
3846 }
3847 }
3848 }
3849
3850 // A stack's literal `padding` list is two spacing steps, vertical then horizontal, each 0 to 5; a panel's is one
3851 // step. A computed padding is read at mount.
3852 static void checkPadding(DocNode const& node) {
3853 ExprPtr const padding = node.prop("padding");
3854 if (padding == nullptr || padding->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
3855 return;
3856 }
3857 ValueList const* const list = padding->literal.asList();
3858 if (list == nullptr) {
3859 return;
3860 }
3861 if (node.kind == "panel") {
3862 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "padding"), "a panel's `padding` is one spacing step, not a list");
3863 }
3864 // The largest spacing step, as `kMaxSpacingStep` (view.hpp) names it.
3865 static constexpr std::int64_t kMostSteps = 5;
3866 bool const steps = list->size() == 2 && std::ranges::all_of(*list, [](Value const& step) {
3867 std::int64_t const* const whole = step.asInt();
3868 return whole != nullptr && *whole >= 0 && *whole <= kMostSteps;
3869 });
3870 if (!steps) {
3871 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "padding"),
3872 "a `padding` list is two spacing steps, vertical then horizontal, each from 0 to 5");
3873 }
3874 }
3875
3876 // The closed-set keys of a button, and the shape and style pair that cannot go together.
3877 static void checkButtonValues(DocNode const& node) {
3878 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 5> kEmphasis = {"normal", "primary", "danger", "ghost",
3879 "dangerOutline"};
3880 checkChoice(node, "emphasis", kEmphasis);
3881 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kStyles = {"push", "item"};
3882 checkChoice(node, "style", kStyles);
3883 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kShapes = {"default", "round", "square"};
3884 checkChoice(node, "shape", kShapes);
3885 if (node.name("shape") == "square" && node.name("style") == "item") {
3886 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "shape"),
3887 "an item fills its line, so it has no square outline; `square` is a push button's");
3888 }
3889 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kSizes = {"normal", "small"};
3890 checkChoice(node, "size", kSizes);
3891 if (std::string_view const weight = node.name("weight"); !weight.empty() && !weightNamed(weight)) {
3892 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "weight"),
3893 "`" + std::string{weight} + "` is not a font weight name, such as `semi-bold`");
3894 }
3895 checkEntryContent(node);
3896 }
3897
3898 // The keys of a kind that take one of a closed set of values, and the pairs of keys that need each other.
3899 static void checkKindValues(DocNode const& node) {
3900 if (node.kind == "column" || node.kind == "row" || node.kind == "panel") {
3901 checkPadding(node);
3902 }
3903 if ((node.kind == "column" || node.kind == "row") && node.flag("headJoined") && !node.flag("pageEdge")) {
3904 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "headJoined"),
3905 "`headJoined` needs `pageEdge`: an inset page has a margin between it and the head");
3906 }
3907 if (node.kind == "button") {
3908 checkButtonValues(node);
3909 } else if (node.kind == "grid") {
3910 checkGrid(node);
3911 } else if (node.kind == "actionBar") {
3912 checkActionBar(node);
3913 } else if (node.kind == "column" && node.flags.contains("wrap")) {
3914 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "wrap"), "only a row wraps; a column has no lines to continue on");
3915 } else if (node.kind == "row" && node.flag("divided") && node.flag("wrap")) {
3916 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "divided"),
3917 "a wrapping row has no single line to rule between; `divided` is for a row that does not `wrap`");
3918 } else if (node.kind == "forEach") {
3919 checkForEachWrap(node);
3920 } else if (node.kind == "menu") {
3921 checkMenu(node);
3922 } else if (node.kind == "badge" && node.prop("removeLabel") != nullptr && node.event("onRemove") == nullptr) {
3923 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "removeLabel"),
3924 "`removeLabel` names a removable badge's remove control; the badge gives no `onRemove`");
3925 } else if (node.kind == "textInput") {
3926 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kCommit = {"change", "blur", "enter"};
3927 checkChoice(node, "commitOn", kCommit);
3928 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kInputEmphases = {"normal", "prominent"};
3929 checkChoice(node, "emphasis", kInputEmphases);
3930 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kInputAligns = {"start", "center", "end"};
3931 checkChoice(node, "align", kInputAligns);
3932 checkMultilineExtras(node);
3933 } else if (node.kind == "select") {
3934 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kStale = {"clear", "keep"};
3935 checkChoice(node, "onStale", kStale);
3936 checkSelectStyle(node);
3937 } else if (node.kind == "text") {
3938 checkText(node);
3939 } else if (node.kind == "banner") {
3940 checkBanner(node);
3941 } else if (node.kind == "badge") {
3942 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kBadgeStyles = {"filled", "outline", "quiet"};
3943 checkChoice(node, "style", kBadgeStyles);
3944 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kBadgeShapes = {"default", "round"};
3945 checkChoice(node, "shape", kBadgeShapes);
3946 } else if (node.kind == "keyValue") {
3947 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kCaptionPlaces = {"inline", "stacked"};
3948 checkChoice(node, "fieldLayout", kCaptionPlaces);
3949 checkCaptionWidth(node, node.name("fieldLayout") != "stacked");
3950 checkItemSpans(node.prop("items"));
3951 } else if (node.kind == "table") {
3952 checkCellPlace(node, "valign");
3953 }
3954 if (node.kind == "form" || node.kind == "collection" || node.kind == "wizard") {
3955 checkFormColumns(node);
3956 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kFieldLayouts = {"stacked", "inline"};
3957 checkChoice(node, "fieldLayout", kFieldLayouts);
3958 checkCaptionWidth(node, node.name("fieldLayout") == "inline");
3959 }
3960 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kAlign = {"start", "center", "end", "stretch"};
3961 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kJustify = {"start", "center", "end", "between"};
3962 checkChoice(node, "align", kAlign);
3963 checkChoice(node, "justify", kJustify);
3964 checkChoice(node, "alignSelf", kAlign);
3965 checkSurfaceValues(node);
3966 }
