3968 // Each form field drawn by a host component.
3969 void checkFieldComponents(DocNode const& form) const {
3970 if (form.kind != "form") {
3971 return;
3972 }
3973 for (DocNodePtr const& record : form.partList("fields")) {
3974 for (DocNodePtr const& field : record->partList("fields")) {
3975 if (!field->name("component").empty()) {
3976 checkFieldComponent(*field);
3977 }
3978 }
3979 }
3980 }
3981
3982 // A form field drawn by a host component: a declared one with a `value` prop and a `change` event, given only
3983 // props it declares, and not beside a `widget`, which would choose the control too.
3984 void checkFieldComponent(DocNode const& field) const {
3985 std::string_view const name = field.name("component");
3986 std::string const where = pointerAppend(field.path, "component");
3987 auto const found = _doc->components.find(name);
3988 if (found == _doc->components.end()) {
3989 refuse(where, "`" + std::string{name} + "` is not a component of this document");
3990 }
3991 Component const& component = found->second;
3992 if (!component.props.contains("value") || !component.events.contains("change")) {
3993 refuse(where, "the component `" + component.name +
3994 "` draws a form field, so it declares a prop `value` and an event `change`");
3995 }
3996 if (field.prop("widget") != nullptr) {
3997 refuse(where, "`component` and `widget` both choose the field's control; give one");
3998 }
3999 for (DocNodePtr const& props : field.partList("props")) {
4000 for (auto const& [prop, value] : props->props) {
4001 if (!component.props.contains(prop)) {
4002 refuse(value->path, "the component `" + component.name + "` declares no prop `" + prop + "`");
4003 }
4004 }
4005 }
4006 }
4007
4008 // The document's top-level parts: a screen head's status badges, actions, menu entries and tools, and the app
4009 // document's navigation badges.
4010 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<DocNodePtr> headParts() const {
4011 std::vector<DocNodePtr> parts = _doc->status;
4012 parts.insert(parts.end(), _doc->actions.begin(), _doc->actions.end());
4013 parts.insert(parts.end(), _doc->menu.begin(), _doc->menu.end());
4014 parts.insert(parts.end(), _doc->tools.begin(), _doc->tools.end());
4015 parts.insert(parts.end(), _doc->navigation.begin(), _doc->navigation.end());
4016 return parts;
4017 }
4018
4019 // The head's tools: each id once, and each one its kind's.
4020 static void checkHeadTools(std::span<DocNodePtr const> tools) {
4021 std::set<std::string_view> ids;
4022 for (DocNodePtr const& tool : tools) {
4023 if (!ids.insert(tool->id).second) {
4024 refuse(pointerAppend(tool->path, "id"),
4025 "the head tool id `" + tool->id + "` is used twice; each tool has its own");
4026 }
4027 checkHeadTool(*tool);
4028 }
4029 }
4030
4031 // One head tool: a kind of the two, only its kind's keys, a select's options in a dropdown, a literal width.
4032 static void checkHeadTool(DocNode const& tool) {
4033 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kSearchOnly = {"value", "placeholder", "onChange",
4034 "onSubmit"};
4035 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kSelectOnly = {"options", "selected", "style", "onChoose"};
4036 std::string_view const kind = tool.name("kind");
4037 if (kind != "search" && kind != "select") {
4038 refuse(pointerAppend(tool.path, "kind"),
4039 "`" + std::string{kind} + "` is not one of the values of `kind`: search or select");
4040 }
4041 bool const search = kind == "search";
4042 for (std::string_view const key : search ? kSelectOnly : kSearchOnly) {
4043 if (tool.prop(key) || tool.event(key) != nullptr || !tool.name(key).empty()) {
4044 refuse(pointerAppend(tool.path, key),
4045 "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a " + (search ? "select" : "search") + " tool's");
4046 }
4047 }
4048 if (!search && !tool.prop("options")) {
4049 refuse(tool.path, "a select tool has `options`");
4050 }
4051 if (std::string_view const style = tool.name("style"); !style.empty() && style != "dropdown") {
4052 refuse(pointerAppend(tool.path, "style"),
4053 "`" + std::string{style} + "` is not one of the values of `style`: dropdown");
4054 }
4055 ExprPtr const width = tool.prop("width");
4056 std::int64_t const* const units = width && width->kind == ExprKind::Literal
4057 ? width->literal.asInt()
4058 : static_cast<std::int64_t const*>(nullptr);
4059 if (width && (units == nullptr || *units < 1)) {
4060 refuse(pointerAppend(tool.path, "width"), "`width` is a literal whole number of units, 1 or more");
4061 }
4062 }
4063
4064 // The head menu's entries, at every level: an entry that is chosen has an id, unique across the whole menu, since
4065 // `ScreenHead::choose` names it by that id; a separator or a submenu is never chosen and takes none.
4066 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): a submenu is a menu one level down.
4067 static void checkHeadMenu(std::span<DocNodePtr const> entries, std::set<std::string_view>& ids) {
4068 for (DocNodePtr const& entry : entries) {
4069 bool const submenu = !entry->partList("items").empty();
4070 if (entry->flag("separator") || submenu) {
4071 if (!entry->id.empty()) {
4072 refuse(pointerAppend(entry->path, "id"),
4073 submenu ? "a submenu is opened, not chosen, and takes no `id`"
4074 : "a separator is a line between entries and takes no other key");
4075 }
4076 checkHeadMenu(entry->partList("items"), ids);
4077 continue;
4078 }
4079 if (entry->id.empty()) {
4080 refuse(entry->path, "a head menu entry has an `id`, which choosing it names");
4081 }
4082 if (!ids.insert(entry->id).second) {
4083 refuse(pointerAppend(entry->path, "id"),
4084 "the head menu entry id `" + entry->id + "` is used twice; each entry has its own");
4085 }
4086 }
4087 }
4088
4089 // A list of `actionButton` parts: each id once, and each emphasis one of a button's.
4090 static void checkActionButtons(std::span<DocNodePtr const> buttons, std::string const& path) {
4091 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 5> kEmphasis = {"normal", "primary", "danger", "ghost",
4092 "dangerOutline"};
4093 std::set<std::string_view> ids;
4094 for (DocNodePtr const& button : buttons) {
4095 if (!ids.insert(button->id).second) {
4096 refuse(pointerAppend(button->path, "id"),
4097 "the action id `" + button->id + "` is used twice in " + path + "; each action has its own");
4098 }
4099 checkChoice(*button, "emphasis", kEmphasis);
4100 }
4101 }
4102
4103 // A literal sizing of one dimension: `"content"`, `{"fixed": n}` (n of 0 or more), `{"stretch": w}` (w of 1 or
4104 // more) or `{"percent": n}` (n from 1 to 100). Answers the fixed amount, if it is one.
4105 static std::optional<std::int64_t> sizingDimension(Value const& value, std::string const& path) {
4106 static constexpr std::string_view kForms =
4107 "`sizing` is `\"content\"`, `{\"fixed\": n}`, `{\"stretch\": w}`, `{\"percent\": n}` (n from 1 to 100), "
4108 "or a "
4109 "record of `width` and `height` of them";
4110 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString(); text != nullptr && *text == "content") {
4111 return std::nullopt;
4112 }
4113 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
4114 if (record != nullptr && record->size() == 1) {
4115 auto const& [form, amount] = *record->begin();
4116 std::int64_t const* const units = amount.asInt();
4117 if (form == "fixed" && units != nullptr && *units >= 0) {
4118 return *units;
4119 }
4120 if (form == "stretch" && units != nullptr && *units >= 1) {
4121 return std::nullopt;
4122 }
4123 if (form == "percent" && units != nullptr && *units >= 1 && *units <= 100) {
4124 return std::nullopt;
4125 }
4126 }
4127 refuse(path, std::string{kForms});
4128 }
4129
4130 // Whether a literal sizing dimension is `{"percent": n}`.
4131 static bool isPercent(Value const& value) {
4132 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
4133 return record != nullptr && record->size() == 1 && record->begin()->first == "percent";
4134 }
4135
4136 // Whether a literal `sizing` gives the node a percent width: as the single form, or as the `width` of a record.
4137 static bool hasPercentWidth(DocNode const& node) {
4138 ExprPtr const sizing = node.prop("sizing");
4139 if (sizing == nullptr || sizing->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
4140 return false;
4141 }
4142 ValueRecord const* const record = sizing->literal.asRecord();
4143 if (record != nullptr && (record->contains("width") || record->contains("height"))) {
4144 auto const found = record->find("width");
4145 return found != record->end() && isPercent(found->second);
4146 }
4147 return isPercent(sizing->literal);
4148 }
4149
4150 // A table column's or a grid track's literal `width` is no share: a track is sized by the grid, a column by its
4151 // table.
4152 static void checkNoPercentWidth(DocNode const& node) {
4153 ExprPtr const width = node.prop("width");
4154 if (width != nullptr && width->kind == ExprKind::Literal && isPercent(width->literal)) {
4155 refuse(width->path, std::string{kPercentPlaces});
4156 }
4157 }
4158
4159 // What a percent sizes: a width along a row or a horizontal splitter's pane.
4160 static constexpr std::string_view kPercentPlaces =
4161 "`percent` sizes a width along a row or a horizontal splitter; nothing here takes a share";
4162
4163 // A node's size keys: each bound a literal integer of 0 or more, a minimum no more than its maximum, no bound on
4164 // an overlay or a custom node; and a literal `sizing` one of the forms the interpreter reads, with a fixed amount
4165 // inside its dimension's bounds. A sizing that is not literal is read at mount.
4166 static void checkLayoutKeys(DocNode const& node) { checkSizing(node, literalBounds(node)); }
4167
4168 // The size bounds a node gives, `minWidth`, `maxWidth`, `minHeight` and `maxHeight` in that order: literal
4169 // integers of 0 or more, no minimum above its maximum, none on an overlay or a custom node.
4170 static std::array<std::optional<std::int64_t>, 4> literalBounds(DocNode const& node) {
4171 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kBounds = {"minWidth", "maxWidth", "minHeight", "maxHeight"};
4172 std::array<std::optional<std::int64_t>, 4> bounds{};
4173 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < kBounds.size(); ++index) {
4174 std::string_view const key = kBounds.at(index);
4175 ExprPtr const bound = node.prop(key);
4176 if (bound == nullptr) {
4177 continue;
4178 }
4179 if (node.kind == "dialog" || node.kind == "drawer") {
4180 refuse(bound->path, "an overlay is sized by the frontend, not by its container");
4181 }
4182 if (node.kind == "custom") {
4183 refuse(bound->path,
4184 "a custom node carries no common properties, so it takes no `" + std::string{key} + "`");
4185 }
4186 std::int64_t const* const units =
4187 bound->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? bound->literal.asInt() : static_cast<std::int64_t const*>(nullptr);
4188 if (units == nullptr || *units < 0) {
4189 refuse(bound->path, "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a literal integer of 0 or more, in backend units");
4190 }
4191 bounds.at(index) = *units;
4192 }
4193 for (std::size_t axis = 0; axis < 2; ++axis) {
4194 auto const& minimum = bounds.at(2 * axis);
4195 auto const& maximum = bounds.at((2 * axis) + 1);
4196 if (minimum && maximum && *minimum > *maximum) {
4197 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, kBounds.at(2 * axis)),
4198 "`" + std::string{kBounds.at(2 * axis)} + "` is more than `" +
4199 std::string{kBounds.at((2 * axis) + 1)} + "`");
4200 }
4201 }
4202 return bounds;
4203 }
4204
4205 // Whether a literal sizing dimension's value is `{"stretch": w}` (as opposed to `"content"` or `{"fixed": n}`,
4206 // which both `sizingDimension` reports the same way -- as "no fixed amount"). An overlay is sized by the
4207 // frontend, not by its container, so stretching it would silently change how every *other* sibling in its own
4208 // parent layout is justified; checked ahead of `sizingDimension` itself, which does not distinguish the two.
4209 static bool isStretch(Value const& value) {
4210 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
4211 return record != nullptr && record->size() == 1 && record->begin()->first == "stretch";
4212 }
4213
4214 // An overlay (`dialog`/`drawer`) refuses a literal `sizing` that stretches either dimension, single-value or
4215 // record form: an overlay is sized by the frontend, not by its container, so stretching it would silently change
4216 // how every *other* sibling in its own parent layout is justified.
4217 static void checkOverlaySizing(DocNode const& node, ExprPtr const& sizing) {
4218 if (node.kind != "dialog" && node.kind != "drawer") {
4219 return;
4220 }
4221 ValueRecord const* const record = sizing->literal.asRecord();
4222 bool const stretches =
4223 isStretch(sizing->literal) ||
4224 (record != nullptr && (record->contains("width") || record->contains("height")) &&
4225 std::ranges::any_of(*record, [](auto const& entry) { return isStretch(entry.second); }));
4226 if (stretches) {
4227 refuse(sizing->path,
4228 "an overlay is sized by the frontend, not by its container; give it `{\"fixed\": n}` instead "
4229 "of `{\"stretch\": w}`");
4230 }
4231 }
4232
4233 // A literal `sizing` gives a percent as neither a height nor the width of an overlay.
4234 static void checkPercentSizing(DocNode const& node, ExprPtr const& sizing) {
4235 ValueRecord const* const record = sizing->literal.asRecord();
4236 if (record != nullptr && record->contains("height") && isPercent(record->at("height"))) {
4237 refuse(sizing->path, std::string{kPercentPlaces});
4238 }
4239 if (hasPercentWidth(node) && (node.kind == "dialog" || node.kind == "drawer")) {
4240 refuse(sizing->path, std::string{kPercentPlaces});
4241 }
4242 }
4243
4244 // A literal `sizing` is one of its forms, and a fixed amount lies inside its dimension's @p bounds.
4245 static void checkSizing(DocNode const& node, std::array<std::optional<std::int64_t>, 4> const& bounds) {
4246 ExprPtr const sizing = node.prop("sizing");
4247 if (sizing == nullptr || sizing->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
4248 return;
4249 }
4250 checkOverlaySizing(node, sizing);
4251 checkPercentSizing(node, sizing);
4252 std::optional<std::int64_t> width;
4253 std::optional<std::int64_t> height;
4254 ValueRecord const* const record = sizing->literal.asRecord();
4255 if (record != nullptr && (record->contains("width") || record->contains("height"))) {
4256 for (auto const& [dimension, value] : *record) {
4257 if (dimension == "width") {
4258 width = sizingDimension(value, sizing->path);
4259 } else if (dimension == "height") {
4260 height = sizingDimension(value, sizing->path);
4261 } else {
4262 refuse(sizing->path, "a `sizing` record has `width` and `height`; `" + dimension + "` is neither");
4263 }
4264 }
4265 } else {
4266 width = sizingDimension(sizing->literal, sizing->path);
4267 }
4268 for (auto const& [fixed, axis] : {std::pair{width, std::size_t{0}}, std::pair{height, std::size_t{1}}}) {
4269 auto const& minimum = bounds.at(2 * axis);
4270 auto const& maximum = bounds.at((2 * axis) + 1);
4271 if (fixed && (*fixed < minimum.value_or(*fixed) || *fixed > maximum.value_or(*fixed))) {
4272 refuse(sizing->path, std::string{"a fixed size has no room to bound: the "} +
4273 (axis == 0 ? "width" : "height") + " is fixed outside its bounds");
4274 }
4275 }
4276 }
4277
4278 // A text's or a table column's literal `role` is one of the roles (`title` is `heading`'s alias); a computed one
4279 // is read at mount, and one of no known name is reported there.
4280 static void checkTextRole(DocNode const& node) {
4281 ExprPtr const role = node.prop("role");
4282 if (role == nullptr || role->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
4283 return;
4284 }
4285 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 14> kRoles = {
4286 "normal", "muted", "heading", "title", "section", "error", "success",
4287 "mono", "display", "small", "overline", "caption", "label", "headline"};
4288 std::string const* const name = role->literal.asString();
4289 if (name == nullptr) {
4290 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "role"), "`role` is a name");
4291 }
4292 if (!listed(kRoles, *name)) {
4293 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "role"), "`" + *name + "` is not one of the values of `role`");
4294 }
4295 }
4296
4297 // A dialog's, drawer's or form's error policy, submit mode and description spans.
4298 static void checkSurfaceValues(DocNode const& node) {
4299 if (node.kind != "dialog" && node.kind != "drawer" && node.kind != "form") {
4300 return;
4301 }
4302 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kPolicies = {"touched", "submit", "always"};
4303 checkChoice(node, "showErrors", kPolicies);
4304 // Absent keeps the schema's own mode, so a misspelt mode would silently do the same.
4305 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kSubmitModes = {"explicit", "auto"};
4306 checkChoice(node, "submit", kSubmitModes);
4307 checkSpans(node.prop("descriptionSpans"));
4308 }
4309
4310 // A text's role and spans; a text carries no description, the line itself is the text.
4311 static void checkText(DocNode const& node) {
4312 checkTextRole(node);
4313 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kTextAligns = {"start", "center", "end"};
4314 checkChoice(node, "align", kTextAligns);
4315 checkSpans(node.prop("spans"));
4316 if (node.prop("description") != nullptr) {
4317 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "description"), "a text is not described; put the line in the text");
4318 }
4319 if (node.prop("labelHint") != nullptr) {
4320 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "labelHint"), "a text has no caption to hint after; put it in the text");
4321 }
4322 }
4323
4324 // A banner's action: its style is one of three; the link style places the action in the message's runs, and a
4325 // stretched action is a button on a line of its own, so it needs an action and is no link.
4326 static void checkBanner(DocNode const& node) {
4327 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kStyles = {"ghost", "button", "link"};
4328 checkChoice(node, "actionStyle", kStyles);
4329 bool const link = node.name("actionStyle") == "link";
4330 checkSpans(node.prop("spans"), link);
4331 if (node.flag("actionStretch")) {
4332 if (link) {
4333 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "actionStretch"),
4334 "`actionStretch` puts a button on a line of its own; a `link` action sits in the message");
4335 }
4336 if (!node.parts.contains("action")) {
4337 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "actionStretch"), "`actionStretch` stretches the banner's `action`");
4338 }
4339 }
4340 }
4341
4342 // What an `action` run is told where the loader refuses it.
4343 static constexpr std::string_view kActionRunPlaces =
4344 "an `action` run is the link of a banner whose `actionStyle` is "
4345 "\"link\"; at most one run of its spans takes it";
4346
4347 // A span list written out: each literal run a string, each record run a `text` with at most the flags `strong`
4348 // and `mono`, each literal flag a boolean. A computed list, or a computed element, is checked as it is drawn. A
4349 // run may carry `action` where @p actionAllowed, once at most.
4350 static void checkSpans(ExprPtr const& spans, bool actionAllowed = false) {
4351 if (spans == nullptr) {
4352 return;
4353 }
4354 int actions = 0;
4355 if (spans->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
4356 ValueList const* const runs = spans->literal.asList();
4357 if (runs == nullptr) {
4358 refuse(spans->path, "`spans` is a list of runs");
4359 }
4360 for (Value const& run : *runs) {
4361 checkLiteralRun(run, spans->path, actionAllowed, actions);
4362 }
4363 return;
4364 }
4365 if (spans->kind != ExprKind::List) {
4366 return;
4367 }
4368 for (ExprPtr const& run : spans->args) {
4369 if (run->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
4370 checkLiteralRun(run->literal, run->path, actionAllowed, actions);
4371 } else if (run->kind == ExprKind::Object) {
4372 checkRunRecord(*run, actionAllowed, actions);
4373 }
4374 }
4375 }
4376
4377 // A button's `children`: only on a list entry, and display kinds only, at any depth, so the entry stays one
4378 // control with one activation. A list of what is allowed keeps a kind added later out until it is judged.
4379 static void checkEntryContent(DocNode const& button) {
4380 auto const found = button.children.find("children");
4381 if (found == button.children.end() || found->second.empty()) {
4382 return;
4383 }
4384 if (button.name("style") != "item") {
4385 refuse(pointerAppend(button.path, "children"),
4386 "only a list entry holds content; a push button has a label");
4387 }
4388 for (DocNodePtr const& child : found->second) {
4389 checkReadOnlyContent(*child);
4390 }
4391 }
4392
4393 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): an entry's content is a tree of nodes.
4394 static void checkReadOnlyContent(DocNode const& node) {
4395 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 12> kDisplay = {"text", "badge", "keyValue", "progress",
4396 "steps", "busy", "spacer", "column",
4397 "row", "grid", "forEach", "switch"};
4398 static constexpr std::string_view kReason =
4399 "an entry's content is read-only; put the control beside the entry";
4400 if (!listed(kDisplay, node.kind)) {
4401 refuse(node.path, std::string{kReason});
4402 }
4403 for (std::string_view const key : {std::string_view{"autofocus"}}) {
4404 if (node.prop(key) != nullptr) {
4405 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, key), std::string{kReason});
4406 }
4407 }
4408 if (!node.keys.empty()) {
4409 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "keys"), std::string{kReason});
4410 }
4411 for (std::string_view const part : {std::string_view{"drag"}, std::string_view{"drop"}}) {
4412 if (!node.partList(part).empty()) {
4413 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, part), std::string{kReason});
4414 }
4415 }
4416 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
4417 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
4418 checkReadOnlyContent(*child);
4419 }
4420 }
4421 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
4422 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
4423 for (auto const& [childKey, nodes] : part->children) {
4424 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
4425 checkReadOnlyContent(*child);
4426 }
4427 }
4428 }
4429 }
4430 }
4431
4432 // A select's style written as a constant: one of the three it may be. A computed one is read as it is drawn.
4433 static void checkSelectStyle(DocNode const& node) {
4434 ExprPtr const style = node.prop("style");
4435 if (style == nullptr || style->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
4436 return;
4437 }
4438 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kStyles = {"dropdown", "radio", "segmented"};
4439 std::string const* const name = style->literal.asString();
4440 if (name == nullptr) {
4441 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "style"), "`style` is a name");
4442 }
4443 if (!listed(kStyles, *name)) {
4444 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "style"), "`" + *name + "` is not one of the values of `style`");
4445 }
4446 }
4447
4448 // A literal multiline text input with a unit or an icon: a text area holds no number and draws no icon.
4449 static void checkMultilineExtras(DocNode const& node) {
4450 ExprPtr const mode = node.prop("mode");
4451 std::string const* const name =
4452 mode != nullptr && mode->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? mode->literal.asString() : nullptr;
4453 if (name == nullptr || *name != "multiline") {
4454 return;
4455 }
4456 for (std::string_view const key :
4457 {std::string_view{"unit"}, std::string_view{"icon"}, std::string_view{"prefix"}}) {
4458 if (node.prop(key) != nullptr) {
4459 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, key), "a multiline input shows no " + std::string{key});
4460 }
4461 }
4462 if (!node.name("align").empty()) {
4463 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "align"), "a multiline input's text starts at the leading edge");
4464 }
4465 if (!node.name("emphasis").empty() && node.name("emphasis") != "normal") {
4466 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "emphasis"), "a multiline input's size is its own; it takes no emphasis");
4467 }
4468 }
4469
4470 // The spans of each key-value item written as an `obj` in a `list`.
4471 static void checkItemSpans(ExprPtr const& items) {
4472 if (items == nullptr || items->kind != ExprKind::List) {
4473 return;
4474 }
4475 for (ExprPtr const& item : items->args) {
4476 if (item->kind != ExprKind::Object) {
4477 continue;
4478 }
4479 for (auto const& [key, value] : item->fields) {
4480 if (key == "spans") {
4481 checkSpans(value);
4482 }
4483 }
4484 }
4485 }
4486
4487 // A literal run's tone: one of the tone names, or null for none.
4488 static void checkLiteralRunTone(Value const& tone, std::string const& path) {
4489 std::string const* const name = tone.asString();
4490 if (tone.isNull()) {
4491 return;
4492 }
4493 if (name == nullptr ||
4494 (*name != "neutral" && *name != "info" && *name != "ok" && *name != "warn" && *name != "err")) {
4495 refuse(path, "a run's `tone` is neutral, info, ok, warn or err");
4496 }
4497 }
4498
4499 // A run marked `action`: allowed in a link banner's spans, once.
4500 static void checkActionRun(std::string const& path, bool actionAllowed, int& actions) {
4501 if (!actionAllowed || ++actions > 1) {
4502 refuse(path, std::string{kActionRunPlaces});
4503 }
4504 }
4505
4506 // A literal run: a string, or a record of a string `text` and boolean flags.
4507 static void checkLiteralRun(Value const& run, std::string const& path, bool actionAllowed, int& actions) {
4508 if (run.asString() != nullptr) {
4509 return;
4510 }
4511 ValueRecord const* const record = run.asRecord();
4512 if (record == nullptr) {
4513 refuse(path, "a run is a string or a record with `text`");
4514 }
4515 if (!record->contains("text")) {
4516 refuse(path, "a run's record gives its `text`");
4517 }
4518 for (auto const& [key, value] : *record) {
4519 if (key != "text" && key != "strong" && key != "mono" && key != "tone" && key != "action") {
4520 refuse(path, "a run takes `text`, `strong`, `mono` and `tone`, not `" + key + "`");
4521 }
4522 if (key == "tone") {
4523 checkLiteralRunTone(value, path);
4524 } else if (key != "text" && value.asBool() == nullptr) {
4525 refuse(path, "a run's `" + key + "` is true or false");
4526 }
4527 if (key == "action" && value.asBool() != nullptr && *value.asBool()) {
4528 checkActionRun(path, actionAllowed, actions);
4529 }
4530 }
4531 }
4532
4533 // A run written as an `obj`: a `text`, and flags that are booleans when written as constants.
4534 static void checkRunRecord(Expr const& run, bool actionAllowed, int& actions) {
4535 bool hasText = false;
4536 for (auto const& [key, value] : run.fields) {
4537 if (key == "text") {
4538 hasText = true;
4539 } else if (key == "tone") {
4540 if (value->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
4541 checkLiteralRunTone(value->literal, value->path);
4542 }
4543 } else if (key != "strong" && key != "mono" && key != "action") {
4544 refuse(value->path, "a run takes `text`, `strong`, `mono` and `tone`, not `" + key + "`");
4545 } else if (value->kind == ExprKind::Literal && value->literal.asBool() == nullptr) {
4546 refuse(value->path, "a run's `" + key + "` is true or false");
4547 } else if (key == "action" && value->kind == ExprKind::Literal && *value->literal.asBool()) {
4548 checkActionRun(value->path, actionAllowed, actions);
4549 }
4550 }
4551 if (!hasText) {
4552 refuse(run.path, "a run's record gives its `text`");
4553 }
4554 }
4555
4556 // A table cell's place across its column and down its row: `stretch`, which a stack takes, is no place for a
4557 // cell.
4558 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 3> kCellPlaces = {"start", "center", "end"};
4559
4560 // A table column's closed sets: its default cell's text role, and its cells' places.
4561 static void checkColumnPart(DocNode const& node) {
4562 checkTextRole(node);
4563 checkCellPlace(node, "align");
4564 checkCellPlace(node, "valign");
4565 }
4566
4567 // Only a horizontal `forEach` wraps and only a vertical one is divided; a literal `axis` that says otherwise is
4568 // refused here, and a computed one is read when the screen lowers.
4569 static void checkForEachWrap(DocNode const& node) {
4570 ExprPtr const axis = node.prop("axis");
4571 if (axis == nullptr || axis->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
4572 return;
4573 }
4574 std::string const* const named = axis->literal.asString();
4575 bool const horizontal = named != nullptr && *named == "horizontal";
4576 if (node.flag("wrap") && !horizontal) {
4577 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "wrap"),
4578 "`wrap` fills lines along a row; this `forEach`'s `axis` is not \"horizontal\"");
4579 }
4580 if (node.flag("divided") && horizontal) {
4581 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "divided"),
4582 "`divided` draws rules between rows of a column; this `forEach`'s `axis` is \"horizontal\"");
4583 }
4584 }
4585
4586 // An action bar's gap is the theme's, and a horizontal `forEach` directly in it is part of that row.
4587 static void checkActionBar(DocNode const& node) {
4588 if (node.prop("gap") != nullptr) {
4589 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "gap"), kActionBarGapRefusal);
4590 }
4591 // A horizontal `forEach` directly in the bar is part of its row of actions, so it takes the same gap.
4592 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
4593 if (child->kind != "forEach" || child->prop("gap") == nullptr) {
4594 continue;
4595 }
4596 ExprPtr const axis = child->prop("axis");
4597 if (axis != nullptr && axis->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
4598 std::string const* const named = axis->literal.asString();
4599 if (named != nullptr && *named == "horizontal") {
4600 refuse(pointerAppend(child->path, "gap"), kActionBarGapRefusal);
4601 }
4602 }
4603 }
4604 }
4605
4606 // A grid's `minColumnWidth`: a literal number of units that has columns to drop, and no tracks, which size their
4607 // own columns. Where it could do nothing, it is refused rather than ignored.
4608 static void checkMinColumnWidth(DocNode const& node) {
4609 ExprPtr const least = node.prop("minColumnWidth");
4610 if (least == nullptr) {
4611 return;
4612 }
4613 std::int64_t const* const units =
4614 least->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? least->literal.asInt() : static_cast<std::int64_t const*>(nullptr);
4615 if (units == nullptr) {
4616 refuse(least->path, "`minColumnWidth` is a literal integer");
4617 }
4618 if (*units < 1 || *units > 64) {
4619 refuse(least->path, "`minColumnWidth` is 1 to 64 units");
4620 }
4621 if (node.parts.contains("tracks")) {
4622 refuse(least->path, "a grid with tracks sizes its own columns; `minColumnWidth` is for equal columns");
4623 }
4624 ExprPtr const columns = node.prop("columns");
4625 if (columns == nullptr) {
4626 refuse(least->path,
4627 "`minColumnWidth` needs `columns`: it drops columns from that count as the grid narrows");
4628 }
4629 if (columns->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
4630 std::int64_t const* const count = columns->literal.asInt();
4631 if (count != nullptr && *count <= 1) {
4632 refuse(least->path, "`minColumnWidth` has nothing to drop from one column");
4633 }
4634 }
4635 }
4636
4637 static void checkGrid(DocNode const& node) {
4638 if (!node.name("justify").empty()) {
4639 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "justify"),
4640 "a grid's columns are sized by their count or tracks; there is no spare length to justify");
4641 }
4642 if (node.prop("selected") != nullptr) {
4643 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "selected"),
4644 "a grid is not an entry of a list; `selected` marks a column or a row");
4645 }
4646 checkMinColumnWidth(node);
4647 auto const tracks = node.parts.find("tracks");
4648 if (tracks == node.parts.end()) {
4649 return;
4650 }
4651 if (node.prop("columns") != nullptr) {
4652 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "tracks"),
4653 "a grid takes `columns` or `tracks`, not both; with `tracks`, the column count is their number");
4654 }
4655 if (tracks->second.empty()) {
4656 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "tracks"), "`tracks` lists at least one track");
4657 }
4658 }
4659
4660 // A menu's style, and its trigger's keys, which only a button-style menu has. An icon-only trigger needs a name
4661 // for assistive technology, so a button-style menu has a `label` or an `a11y` name.
4662 static void checkMenu(DocNode const& node) {
4663 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 2> kStyles = {"bar", "button"};
4664 checkChoice(node, "style", kStyles);
4665 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 4> kEmphasis = {"normal", "primary", "danger", "ghost"};
4666 checkChoice(node, "emphasis", kEmphasis);
4667 if (node.name("style") != "button") {
4668 for (std::string_view const key : {"label", "icon"}) {
4669 if (node.prop(key) != nullptr) {
4670 refuse(
4671 pointerAppend(node.path, key),
4672 "`" + std::string{key} + "` is a button-style menu's trigger; give the menu `style: button`");
4673 }
4674 }
4675 if (!node.name("emphasis").empty()) {
4676 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "emphasis"),
4677 "`emphasis` is a button-style menu's trigger; give the menu `style: button`");
4678 }
4679 return;
4680 }
4681 auto const a11y = node.partList("a11y");
4682 bool const named = !a11y.empty() && a11y.front()->prop("name") != nullptr;
4683 if (node.prop("label") == nullptr && !named) {
4684 refuse(node.path,
4685 "a button-style menu has a `label` or an `a11y` name, so its trigger has a name for "
4686 "assistive technology");
4687 }
4688 }

4690 // A separator is a line between entries: `true`, and nothing else beside it.
4691 // Whether a part kind is a menu entry: a `menu` node's or a screen head's.
4692 [[nodiscard]] static bool isMenuEntry(std::string_view kind) {
4693 return kind == "menuItem" || kind == "headMenuItem";
4694 }
4695
4696 static void checkMenuItem(DocNode const& node) {
4697 if (!node.flags.contains("separator")) {
4698 return;
4699 }
4700 if (!node.flag("separator")) {
4701 refuse(pointerAppend(node.path, "separator"), "`separator` is `true`; leave it out for an entry");
4702 }
4703 bool const alone = node.props.empty() && node.events.empty() && node.parts.empty() && node.names.empty() &&
4704 node.keys.empty() && node.flags.size() == 1;
4705 if (!alone) {
4706 refuse(node.path, "a separator is a line between entries and takes no other key");
4707 }
4708 }

4710 // A cell place, which names the three it may be.
4711 static void checkCellPlace(DocNode const& node, std::string_view key) {
4712 std::string_view const value = node.name(key);
4713 if (!value.empty() && !listed(kCellPlaces, value)) {

4719 // A form's `columns`: a literal integer, 1 to 12, the `x-colspan` convention's full row.
4720 static void checkFormColumns(DocNode const& node) {
4721 ExprPtr const columns = node.prop("columns");

4727 if (count == nullptr) {

4735 // A `captionWidth`: a literal integer, 1 to 64, which needs a caption column, so inline captions.
4736 static void checkCaptionWidth(DocNode const& node, bool inlineCaptions) {
4737 ExprPtr const width = node.prop("captionWidth");

4739 return;
4740 }
4741 std::int64_t const* const units =
4742 width->kind == ExprKind::Literal ? width->literal.asInt() : static_cast<std::int64_t const*>(nullptr);
4743 if (units == nullptr) {

4754 static void checkChoice(DocNode const& node, std::string_view key, std::span<std::string_view const> choices) {
4755 std::string_view const value = node.name(key);
4756 if (!value.empty() && !listed(choices, value)) {

4758 "`" + std::string{value} + "` is not one of the values of `" + std::string{key} + "`");

4761
4762 void checkCommands(Commands const& commands, CheckContext const& context, bool sequence = false) {
4763 CheckContext current = context;
4764 current.commands = true;
4765 for (Command const& cmd : commands) {
4766 checkCommand(cmd, current);
4767 if (sequence && cmd.kind == CommandKind::Run && !cmd.binding.empty() && !cmd.extra) {
4768 current.bindings.emplace_back(cmd.binding, Type::any());
4769 }
4770 }
4771 }
4772
4773 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per command of ui/1.
4774 void checkCommand(Command const& cmd, CheckContext const& context) {
4775 std::string const where = cmd.path;
4776 switch (cmd.kind) {
4777 case CommandKind::Set:
4778 checkSet(cmd, context);
4779 break;
4780 case CommandKind::Reset: {
4781 NameEntry const& entry = require(context, cmd.target, where,
4782 {NameCategory::State, NameCategory::Element}, "state or a dialog");
4783 if (entry.category == NameCategory::Element && entry.element->kind != "dialog" &&
4784 entry.element->kind != "drawer") {
4785 refuse(where, "`reset` restores state, or the state of a dialog; `" + cmd.target + "` is a " +
4786 entry.element->kind);
4787 }
4788 break;
4789 }
4790 case CommandKind::Run: {
4791 static_cast<void>(require(context, cmd.target, where, {NameCategory::Mutation}, "a mutation"));
4792 CheckContext body = context;
4793 if (cmd.extra) {
4794 checkExpr(*cmd.extra, context);
4795 if (!cmd.binding.empty()) {
4796 body.bindings.emplace_back(cmd.binding, Type::any());
4797 }
4798 }
4799 if (cmd.value) {
4800 checkExpr(*cmd.value, body);
4801 }
4802 break;
4803 }
4804 case CommandKind::Refetch:
4805 static_cast<void>(require(context, cmd.target, where, {NameCategory::Query}, "a query"));
4806 break;
4807 case CommandKind::Open:
4808 case CommandKind::Close:
4809 if (cmd.kind == CommandKind::Close && cmd.target == "self") {
4810 break;
4811 }
4812 checkDialog(cmd, context);
4813 break;
4814 case CommandKind::Focus:
4815 checkFocus(cmd, context);
4816 break;
4817 case CommandKind::ResetPrefs:
4818 if (cmd.target != "all" && !_doc->customize.contains(cmd.target)) {
4819 refuse(where, "`" + cmd.target + "` is not a customization point of this document");
4820 }
4821 break;
4822 case CommandKind::If:
4823 checkCondition(*cmd.value, context, "the condition of `if`");
4824 checkCommands(cmd.commands, context);
4825 checkCommands(cmd.alternative, context);
4826 break;
4827 case CommandKind::Seq:
4828 checkCommands(cmd.commands, context, true);
4829 break;
4830 case CommandKind::All:
4831 case CommandKind::Navigate:
4832 if (cmd.value) {
4833 checkExpr(*cmd.value, context);
4834 }
4835 if (cmd.extra) {
4836 checkExpr(*cmd.extra, context);
4837 }
4838 checkCommands(cmd.commands, context);
4839 checkCommands(cmd.alternative, context);
4840 break;
4841 case CommandKind::CancelClose:
4842 if (!context.onClose) {
4843 refuse(where, "`cancelClose` is valid only in `onClose`");
4844 }
4845 break;
4846 case CommandKind::Retry:
4847 if (!context.boundaryError) {
4848 refuse(where, "`retry` is valid only inside a boundary's `error`");
4849 }
4850 break;
4851 case CommandKind::SignIn:
4852 static_cast<void>(require(context, cmd.target, where, {NameCategory::Mutation}, "a mutation"));
4853 break;
4854 case CommandKind::Upload:
4855 static_cast<void>(require(context, cmd.target, where, {NameCategory::Mutation}, "a mutation"));
4856 checkExpr(*cmd.value, context);
4857 break;
4858 case CommandKind::Download:
4859 checkExpr(*cmd.value, context);
4860 if (cmd.extra) {
4861 checkExpr(*cmd.extra, context);
4862 }
4863 if (cmd.mediaType) {
4864 checkExpr(*cmd.mediaType, context);
4865 }
4866 if (cmd.option == "preview") {
4867 static_cast<void>(require(context, cmd.target, where, {NameCategory::State}, "state"));
4868 }
4869 break;
4870 case CommandKind::Return:
4871 case CommandKind::Host:
4872 case CommandKind::Notify:
4873 case CommandKind::SwitchBackend:
4874 case CommandKind::SetLocale:
4875 case CommandKind::SignOut:
4876 default:
4877 if (cmd.value) {
4878 checkExpr(*cmd.value, context);
4879 }
4880 break;
4881 }

4886 if (entry.element->kind != "dialog" && entry.element->kind != "drawer") {

4891 void checkSet(Command const& cmd, CheckContext const& context) {
4892 auto const segments = splitPath(cmd.target);
4893 std::string const& head = segments->front();
4894 Type const value = checkExpr(*cmd.value, context);
4895 if (head == "app") {
4896 return;
4897 }
4898 NameEntry& entry =
4899 require(context, head, cmd.path, {NameCategory::State, NameCategory::Element}, "state or an input");
4900 if (entry.category == NameCategory::Element) {
4901 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(entry.element->kind, false);
4902 if ((spec->flags & kWritable) == 0) {
4903 // A table's state is the document's: it binds its `selection`, `sort` or `page` to state, and the
4904 // state is set.
4905 std::string const hint = entry.element->kind == "table"
4906 ? ": bind its `selection`, `sort` or `page` to state and set that"
4907 : "";
4908 refuse(cmd.path,
4909 "`set` writes state or an input's draft; `" + head + "` is a " + entry.element->kind + hint);
4910 }
4911 return;
4912 }
4913 auto const type = derivedType(entry, head);
4914 if (type && segments->size() == 1 && !compatible(*type, value)) {
4915 refuse(cmd.value->path, "`" + head + "` is " + type->name() + "; the value is " + value.name());
4916 }

4919 /// The state and elements an expression reads, through the `let` entries it reads.
4920 void reads(Expr const& expr, ScopeInfo* scope, std::set<NameEntry const*>& out, std::vector<std::string>& locals,
4921 std::set<NameEntry const*>& seenLets) {
4922 if (expr.kind == ExprKind::Ref && std::ranges::find(locals, expr.name) == locals.end()) {
4923 NameEntry const* const entry = lookup(scope, expr.name);
4924 if (entry != nullptr &&
4925 (entry->category == NameCategory::State || entry->category == NameCategory::Element)) {
4926 out.insert(entry);
4927 } else if (entry != nullptr && entry->category == NameCategory::Let && seenLets.insert(entry).second) {
4928 std::vector<std::string> inner;
4929 reads(*entry->derivedFrom, entry->scope, out, inner, seenLets);
4930 }
4931 }
4932 bool const binds = bindsElement(expr.kind);
4933 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < expr.args.size(); ++index) {
4934 if (binds && index == 1) {
4935 locals.push_back(expr.name);
4936 }
4937 reads(*expr.args.at(index), scope, out, locals, seenLets);
4938 if (binds && index == 1) {
4939 locals.pop_back();
4940 }
4941 }
4942 for (auto const& [name, field] : expr.fields) {
4943 static_cast<void>(name);
4944 reads(*field, scope, out, locals, seenLets);
4945 }
4946 }
4947
4948 /// The state and elements a command list writes.
4949 static void writes(Commands const& commands, ScopeInfo* scope, std::set<NameEntry const*>& out) {
4950 for (Command const& cmd : commands) {
4951 if (cmd.kind == CommandKind::Set || cmd.kind == CommandKind::Reset) {
4952 auto const segments = splitPath(cmd.target);
4953 NameEntry const* const entry = lookup(scope, segments->front());
4954 if (entry != nullptr) {
4955 out.insert(entry);
4956 }
4957 }
4958 writes(cmd.commands, scope, out);
4959 writes(cmd.alternative, scope, out);
4960 }
4961 }
4962
4963 void checkWatchGraph() {
4964 std::size_t const count = _watches.size();
4965 std::vector<std::set<NameEntry const*>> observed(count);
4966 std::vector<std::set<NameEntry const*>> written(count);
4967 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
4968 auto const& [watch, scope] = _watches.at(index);
4969 std::vector<std::string> locals;
4970 std::set<NameEntry const*> seenLets;
4971 reads(*watch->on, scope, observed.at(index), locals, seenLets);
4972 writes(watch->body, scope, written.at(index));
4973 }
4974 // 0 unvisited, 1 on the current path, 2 finished.
4975 std::vector<int> state(count, 0);
4976 std::vector<std::size_t> trail;
4977 std::function<void(std::size_t)> visit = [&](std::size_t from) {
4978 state.at(from) = 1;
4979 trail.push_back(from);
4980 for (std::size_t to = 0; to < count; ++to) {
4981 bool edge = false;
4982 for (NameEntry const* entry : written.at(from)) {
4983 edge = edge || observed.at(to).contains(entry);
4984 }
4985 if (!edge) {
4986 continue;
4987 }
4988 if (state.at(to) == 1) {
4989 std::string cycle;
4990 auto const start = std::ranges::find(trail, to);
4991 for (auto step = start; step != trail.end(); ++step) {
4992 cycle += _watches.at(*step).first->path + " → ";
4993 }
4994 refuse(_watches.at(to).first->path,
4995 "the watch graph has a cycle: " + cycle + _watches.at(to).first->path);
4996 }
4997 if (state.at(to) == 0) {
4998 visit(to);
4999 }
5000 }
5001 trail.pop_back();
5002 state.at(from) = 2;
5003 };
5004 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
5005 if (state.at(index) == 0) {
5006 visit(index);
5007 }
5008 }
5009 }

5011 // The effect checks below read only what the catalog says about each action. They warn only where the
5012 // effects certainly cover, or certainly miss, what the document declares, because a warning a document cannot
5013 // act on would teach its author to ignore the rest.
5014
5015 /// The effects as a phrase, such as "`changes T_Row`, `none`".
5016 [[nodiscard]] static std::string describeEffects(std::vector<ActionEffect> const& effects) {
5017 std::string out;
5018 for (ActionEffect const& effect : effects) {
5019 out += (out.empty() ? "`" : ", `") + effect.kind + (effect.record ? " " + *effect.record : "") + "`";
5020 }
5021 return out;
5022 }
5023
5024 /// Whether an action's effects change anything; `none` alone does not.
5025 [[nodiscard]] static bool changesData(ActionInfo const& info) {
5026 return info.effects &&
5027 std::ranges::any_of(*info.effects, [](ActionEffect const& effect) { return effect.kind != "none"; });
5028 }

5030 void warn(LoadWarningKind kind, std::string path, std::string text) {
5031 _warnings.push_back(LoadWarning{.kind = kind, .path = std::move(path), .text = std::move(text)});
5032 }
5033
5034 void checkEffects() {
5035 if (!_options->catalog.action) {
5036 return;
5037 }
5038 for (auto const& entry : _mutations) {
5039 checkMutationEffects(*entry.first);
5040 }
5041 for (auto const& [watch, scope] : _watches) {
5042 checkWatchFeedback(*watch, scope);
5043 }
5044 }
5045
5046 void checkMutationEffects(MutationDecl const& mutation) {
5047 auto const action = _options->catalog.action(mutation.action);
5048 if (!action) {
5049 return;
5050 }
5051 if (!action->effects && !refetches(mutation.onSuccess)) {
5052 warn(LoadWarningKind::Uncovered, mutation.path,
5053 std::format("nothing refreshes after `{}` succeeds: `{}` declares no effects, and no `refetch` "
5054 "follows it; declare what it changes, or `effects::none` when it changes nothing",
5055 mutation.name, mutation.action));
5056 }
5057 }

5059 /// Whether a command list refetches a query, which is a refresh the document declares itself.
5060 [[nodiscard]] static bool refetches(Commands const& commands) {
5061 return std::ranges::any_of(commands, [](Command const& cmd) {
5062 return cmd.kind == CommandKind::Refetch || refetches(cmd.commands) || refetches(cmd.alternative);
5063 });
5064 }

5066 // Another client's change refetches the watched query, the watch runs the mutation, and its change reaches the
5067 // other client, which may do the same. Only `"source": "user"` keeps a refetch from running the watch.
5068 void checkWatchFeedback(WatchDecl const& watch, ScopeInfo* scope) {
5069 if (watch.source == WatchSource::User) {
5070 return;
5071 }
5072 std::vector<std::string> locals;
5073 std::set<NameEntry const*> seenLets;
5074 auto const query = readQuery(*watch.on, scope, locals, seenLets);
5075 if (!query) {
5076 return;
5077 }
5078 if (auto const mutation = runsWriter(watch.body, scope)) {
5079 warn(LoadWarningKind::WatchFeedback, watch.path,
5080 std::format("the watch reads the query `{}` and runs `{}`, which changes data: another client's "
5081 "change refetches the query and runs it again; give the watch \"source\": \"user\"",
5082 *query, *mutation));
5083 }
5084 }

5086 /// The first query whose value an expression reads, directly or through a `let`.
5087 [[nodiscard]] static std::optional<std::string> readQuery(Expr const& expr, ScopeInfo* scope,
5088 std::vector<std::string>& locals,
5089 std::set<NameEntry const*>& seenLets) {
5090 if (expr.kind == ExprKind::Query) {
5091 return expr.name;
5092 }
5093 if (expr.kind == ExprKind::Ref && std::ranges::find(locals, expr.name) == locals.end()) {
5094 NameEntry const* const entry = lookup(scope, expr.name);
5095 if (entry != nullptr && entry->category == NameCategory::Query) {
5096 return expr.name;
5097 }
5098 if (entry != nullptr && entry->category == NameCategory::Let && seenLets.insert(entry).second) {
5099 std::vector<std::string> inner;
5100 if (auto found = readQuery(*entry->derivedFrom, entry->scope, inner, seenLets)) {
5101 return found;
5102 }
5103 }
5104 }
5105 bool const binds = bindsElement(expr.kind);
5106 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < expr.args.size(); ++index) {
5107 if (binds && index == 1) {
5108 locals.push_back(expr.name);
5109 }
5110 auto found = readQuery(*expr.args.at(index), scope, locals, seenLets);
5111 if (binds && index == 1) {
5112 locals.pop_back();
5113 }
5114 if (found) {
5115 return found;
5116 }
5117 }
5118 for (auto const& [name, field] : expr.fields) {
5119 static_cast<void>(name);
5120 if (auto found = readQuery(*field, scope, locals, seenLets)) {
5121 return found;
5122 }
5123 }
5124 return std::nullopt;
5125 }
5126
5127 /// The first mutation a command list runs whose action changes data.
5128 [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::string> runsWriter(Commands const& commands, ScopeInfo* scope) const {
5129 for (Command const& cmd : commands) {
5130 bool const runs =
5131 cmd.kind == CommandKind::Run || cmd.kind == CommandKind::Upload || cmd.kind == CommandKind::SignIn;
5132 NameEntry const* const entry = runs ? lookup(scope, cmd.target) : nullptr;
5133 if (entry != nullptr && entry->mutation != nullptr) {
5134 auto const action = _options->catalog.action(entry->mutation->action);
5135 if (action && changesData(*action)) {
5136 return cmd.target;
5137 }
5138 }
5139 if (auto found = runsWriter(cmd.commands, scope)) {
5140 return found;
5141 }
5142 if (auto found = runsWriter(cmd.alternative, scope)) {
5143 return found;
5144 }
5145 }
5146 return std::nullopt;
5147 }
5148
5149 Document const* _doc;
5150 LoadOptions const* _options;
5151 std::deque<ScopeInfo> _scopes;
5152 std::map<DocNode const*, ScopeInfo*> _scopeOf;
5153 std::map<DocNode const*, ScopeInfo*> _innerOf;
5154 std::map<std::string, QueryDecl const*, std::less<>> _queries;
5155 std::map<std::string, DocNode const*, std::less<>> _elements;
5156 std::vector<std::pair<WatchDecl const*, ScopeInfo*>> _watches;
5157 std::vector<std::pair<MutationDecl const*, ScopeInfo*>> _mutations;
5158 std::vector<std::pair<QueryDecl const*, ScopeInfo*>> _queryScopes;
5159 std::vector<LoadWarning> _warnings;
5160 std::map<DocNode const*, TypeKind> _dateValueKinds;
5161 std::map<std::string, FocusTarget, std::less<>> _focusTargets;
5162 std::vector<std::string> _deriving;
5163 // NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
5164};

5166// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of name.
5167inline std::expected<Type, std::string> ScopeResolver::ref(std::string_view head,
5168 std::span<std::string const> path) const {
5169 for (auto const& [name, type] : std::views::reverse(_context.bindings)) {
5170 if (name == head) {
5171 return typeAlong(type, head, path);
5172 }
5173 }
5174 if (head == "event") {
5175 if (!_context.commands) {
5176 return std::unexpected(std::string{"`event` is read only inside a command list"});
5177 }
5178 return Type::any();
5179 }
5180 if (head == "app") {
5181 return Type::any();
5182 }
5183 if (head == "boundary") {
5184 if (!_context.boundaryError || path.size() != 1 || path.front() != "error") {
5185 return std::unexpected(std::string{"`boundary.error` is read only inside a boundary's `error`"});
5186 }
5187 return Type::of(TypeKind::String, true);
5188 }
5189 NameEntry* const entry = DocumentValidator::lookup(_context.scope, head);
5190 if (entry == nullptr) {
5191 return std::unexpected("`" + std::string{head} + "` does not resolve in this scope");
5192 }
5193 switch (entry->category) {
5194 case NameCategory::Param:
5195 return typeAlong(entry->type, head, path);
5196 case NameCategory::State:
5197 case NameCategory::Let: {
5198 auto type = _validator.derivedType(*entry, head);
5199 if (!type) {
5200 return type;
5201 }
5202 return typeAlong(*type, head, path);
5203 }
5204 case NameCategory::Query:
5205 return Type::any();
5206 case NameCategory::Mutation:
5207 return std::unexpected("`" + std::string{head} +
5208 "` is a mutation; read it with `result`, `pending` or "
5209 "`error`");
5210 case NameCategory::Model:
5211 return std::unexpected("`" + std::string{head} + "` is a model alias, not a value");
5212 case NameCategory::Transfer:
5213 if (path.empty() || !listed(kTransferValues, path.front())) {
5214 return std::unexpected("the transfer `" + std::string{head} +
5215 "` is read as `progress`, `pending` or `error`");
5216 }
5217 return Type::any();
5218 case NameCategory::Element:
5219 default: {
5220 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(entry->element->kind, false);
5221 if (path.empty()) {
5222 return std::unexpected("the element `" + std::string{head} +
5223 "` is read through one of its values, "
5224 "such as `" +
5225 std::string{head} + ".visible`");
5226 }
5227 std::string const& value = path.front();
5228 bool const open = (spec->flags & kOpenValues) != 0;
5229 bool const known = listed(kAnyValues, value) || listed(spec->values, value) || open;
5230 if (!known) {
5231 return std::unexpected("the " + entry->element->kind + " `" + std::string{head} + "` has no value `" +
5232 value + "`");
5233 }
5234 bool const field = open && !listed(kAnyValues, value) && !listed(spec->values, value);
5235 Type const type = field ? Type::any() : elementValueType(value);
5236 return typeAlong(type, value, path.subspan(1));
5237 }
5238 }
5239}

5242 static_cast<void>(path);
5243 for (ScopeInfo const* scope = _context.scope; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent) {

5251inline std::expected<Type, std::string> ScopeResolver::control(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const {
5252 if (form == ExprKind::Can && name.starts_with("host:")) {
5253 return Type::of(TypeKind::Bool);
5254 }
5255 NameEntry const* const entry = DocumentValidator::lookup(_context.scope, name);
5256 bool const query = entry != nullptr && entry->category == NameCategory::Query;
5257 bool const mutation = entry != nullptr && entry->category == NameCategory::Mutation;
5258 if (form == ExprKind::Query && !query) {
5259 return std::unexpected("`" + std::string{name} + "` is not a query of this scope");
5260 }
5261 if (form == ExprKind::Result && !mutation) {
5262 return std::unexpected("`" + std::string{name} + "` is not a mutation of this scope");
5263 }
5264 if (!query && !mutation) {
5265 return std::unexpected("`" + std::string{name} + "` is not a query or mutation of this scope");
5266 }
5267 if (form == ExprKind::Pending || form == ExprKind::Can) {
5268 return Type::of(TypeKind::Bool);
5269 }
5270 if (form == ExprKind::Error || form == ExprKind::ErrorKind) {
5271 return Type::of(TypeKind::String, true);
5272 }
5273 return Type::any();
5274}

5288/// @brief Parses a UI document and runs its load-time validation (spec 5 §3).
5289///
5290/// A document is refused when it does not parse, when a reference does not resolve, when a type does not check,
5291/// when the `let` or `watch` graph has a cycle, when an expression exceeds 256 nodes, when a node kind, command or
5292/// function is not in the vocabulary, when a document declares `invalidates`, `patch` or `refreshOn`, when a
5293/// must-understand key is unknown, or when a rule of spec 5 or spec 6 fails; the list is in
5294/// `docs/spec/ui/document.md`. The rules that need catalog facts run when @p options supplies them.
5295/// @param json The document's JSON.
5296/// @param options The catalog facts.
5297/// @return The document, with what validation found that does not refuse it in `Document::warnings`, or the first
5298/// refusal, naming the document id, the JSON Pointer and the reason.
5299[[nodiscard]] inline std::expected<Document, Refusal> loadDocument(Json const& json, LoadOptions const& options = {}) {
5300 std::string documentId;
5301 if (auto const* const object = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&json.data)) {
5302 auto const* const found = object->find("id");
5303 if (found != object->end()) {
5304 if (auto const* const text = std::get_if<std::string>(&found->second.data)) {
5305 documentId = *text;
5306 }
5307 }
5308 }
5309 try {
5310 Document doc = detail::DocumentParser{}.parse(json);
5311 detail::DocumentValidator validator{doc, options};
5312 validator.run();
5313 doc.warnings = validator.takeWarnings();
5314 doc.dateValueKinds = validator.takeDateValueKinds();
5315 doc.focusTargets = validator.takeFocusTargets();
5316 return doc;
5317 } catch (detail::DocumentRefused const& refused) {
5318 Refusal refusal = refused.refusal();
5319 refusal.document = documentId;
5320 return std::unexpected(std::move(refusal));
5321 }
5322}
5323
5324/// @brief Parses JSON text as a UI document and runs its load-time validation.
5325/// @param text The document's JSON text.
5326/// @param options The catalog facts.
5327/// @return The document, or the refusal; text that is not JSON is refused at the root.
5328[[nodiscard]] inline std::expected<Document, Refusal> loadDocumentText(std::string_view text,
5329 LoadOptions const& options = {}) {
5330 auto json = parseJson(text);
5331 if (!json) {
5332 return std::unexpected(Refusal{.document = {}, .path = "", .reason = std::move(json.error())});
5333 }
5334 return loadDocument(*json, options);
5335}
